成化二年進士登科錄

玉音

成化二年二月二十六日，禮部尚書臣姚夔等於奉天門奏，為科舉事：會試選中舉人三百五十三名，本年三月初一日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官少保、吏部尚書兼華蓋殿大學士李賢等四十四員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二名、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
光祿大夫、柱國、少保、吏部尚書兼華蓋殿大學士李賢〔癸丑進士〕
榮祿大夫、太子太保兼吏部尚書王翺〔乙未進士〕
資德大夫、正治上卿、太子少保、戶部尚書馬昂〔貢士〕
translation_en:
Record of Metropolitan Graduates of the Second Year of the Chenghua Reign (1466)

Imperial Pronouncement

On the twenty-sixth day of the second month of the second year of the Chenghua reign, Minister of Rites Your Servant Yao Kui 姚夔 and others submitted a memorial at the Fengtian Gate concerning civil service examination matters: The Metropolitan Examination has selected 353 provincial graduates (juren), and on the first day of the third month of the current year, the Palace Examination is to be held. It is proper to request forty-four officials to serve as Readers of the Examination Papers and Officiating Officials, headed by Li Xian 李賢, Junior Guardian, Minister of Personnel, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall. As for the grades of qualification granted to the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), in reverent accordance with the qualifications imperially established by Grand Progenitor Emperor Gao (Taizu): in the First Class, by precedent three candidates are selected, the first-ranked being accorded rank 6b, and the second- and third-ranked rank 7a, conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); the Second Class is accorded rank 7b, conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); the Third Class is accorded rank 8a, conferred the title of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen). We received the Imperial Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Readers of the Examination Papers
Li Xian 李賢, Grandee of the Thirty-eighth Class (guanglu dafu), Pillar of State, Junior Guardian, Minister of Personnel, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall (Metropolitan Graduate of the guichou year [1433]).
Wang Ao 王翺, Grandee of the Thirty-ninth Class (ronglu dafu), Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and concurrently Minister of Personnel (Metropolitan Graduate of the yiwei year [1415]).
Ma Ang 馬昂, Grandee of the Fortieth Class (zide dafu), Senior Director of Upright Administration (zhengzhi shangqing), Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Revenue (Tribute Student [gongshi]).

Sequence of Imperial Honors
Second Year of the Chenghua Era (1466)
Early on the first day of the third month, the tribute scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. His Majesty attended the Hall of Heaven's Mandate (Fengtian dian) and personally bestowed the policy question.
Early on the third day of the third month, all civil and military officials attended in court dress, arrayed in ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyi wei) set out the Imperial Procession Guard (lubu) upon the Cinnabar Steps (danbi) and within the Cinnabar Courtyard (danchi). His Majesty attended the Hall of Heaven's Mandate, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglu si) transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names of the graduates. Officials of the Ministry of Rites (Libu) carried the Yellow Placard (huangbang), led out with drums and music to be posted outside the Left Chang'an Gate (Chang'an zuomen). Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture (Shuntian fu) escorted the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with a ceremonial parasol and retinue.

translation_en:
… [The Emperor] bestowed a banquet at the Ministry of Rites (Libu 禮部). When the banquet concluded, [the graduates] proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi 鴻臚寺) to rehearse the court rituals.
On the fifth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan 狀元) was bestowed court dress, a cap, and a belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi 進士) were bestowed paper money (baochao 寶鈔).
On the sixth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in presenting a memorial (biao 表) to express gratitude for imperial grace.
On the seventh day of the third month, the Principal Graduate and the metropolitan graduates visited the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius (Xianshi Kongzi miao 先師孔子廟) to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai li 釋菜禮). The Ministry of Rites submitted a memorial requesting that the Ministry of Works (Gongbu 工部) be commanded to erect a stone stele inscribed with their names at the Directorate of Education (Guozijian 國子監).

translation_en:
He Qin 賀欽 (a native of Dinghai County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in an official household of the Guangning Rear Tun Guard in Liaodong; Military Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kegong 克恭; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the eleventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was He Ruiqing 瑞卿, his grandfather was He Zhide 志德, his father was He Mengyuan 孟員, his father's first wife was née Zhang 張氏, and his mother is née Guo 郭氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are He Xiang 祥 (Company Commander), He Zhen 禎, He Qi 祺, He Fu 福, He Lu 祿, He Gui 禬, and He Li 禮, and his younger brother is He Tang 禟. He married née Xi 席氏. He ranked 2nd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 184th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Tinggui 楊廷貴 (registered in a civilian household of Yuechi County, Guang'an Subprefecture, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rujue 汝爵; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Xin 信 (County Magistrate), his grandfather was Yang Heng 亨, his father is Yang Yong 顒, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Yang Tingfu 廷富, and his younger brother is Yang Tingyong 廷用. He married née Yue 樂氏. He ranked 24th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 342nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bao Kekuan 鮑克寬 (a native of Shouzhou, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], registered in an official household of the Yanzhou Escort Guard; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Lizhi 栗之; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Bao Tong 同 (Brigade Commander in the Yuan dynasty, served as Vice Guard Commander), his grandfather was Bao Zao 藻 (posthumously honoured as Assistant Guard Commander), his father is Bao Xun 珣 (Assistant Guard Commander), and his mother is née Xu 徐氏 (invested as Respectful Lady). Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Bao Kegong 克恭 (Company Commander), and his younger brothers are Bao Kexin 克信, Bao Kemin 克敏, and Bao Kehui 克惠. He married née Kong 孔氏, and subsequently married née Wei 魏氏. He ranked 26th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 270th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shu Qing 舒清 (registered in a military household of Dexing County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Benzhi 本直; tenth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twelfth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Shu Zhongwu 仲吾, his grandfather was Shu Zhaoyuan 昭遠, his father is Shu Hu 琥, and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Shu Hong 洪, and his younger brothers are Shu Ze 澤, Shu Cang 滄, Shu Sheng 澠, Shu Ying 濙, and Shu Jin 津. He married née Cheng 程氏. He ranked 12th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 25th in the Metropolitan Examination.

A Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Shixi, he is the second son in his generation, and he is twenty-nine years old, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Bi Weijing; his grandfather was Bi Siwen; his father is Bi Ang; his mother is née Yao. Both parents are living. He has an elder brother, Bi Zongguang, and younger brothers, Bi Zongdao and Bi Zongde. He married a woman née Tu. He ranked sixteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jie 李傑: Registered in a military household in Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili). A National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Shixian, he is the first son in his generation, and he is twenty-four years old, born on the fifth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Li Juren; his grandfather is Li Gongji; his father is Li Xiyuan; his mother is née Xu. Both parents and grandparents are living. He has younger brothers, Li Fu and Li Fang. He married a woman née Zhang. He ranked one hundred fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ping 王坪: Registered in a civilian household in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture. A National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), his courtesy name is Xinzhi, he is the second son in his generation, and he is thirty-four years old, born on the twenty-third day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Wang Cheng; his grandfather was Wang Fushun; his father is Wang Xun (Prefectural Director of Schools); his mother is née Meng. Both parents are living. He has an elder brother, Wang Zeng, and a younger brother, Wang Deng (Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue). He married a woman née Yang. He ranked twelfth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and sixty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Shan 錢山: Registered in a military household in Chuzhou, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili). A Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Jingfu, he is the first son in his generation, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Qian Runfu; his grandfather was Qian Datong; his father is Qian Jinghua; his mother is née Liu. Both parents are living. He married a woman née Huang. He ranked twenty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhai Ying 翟瑛 (originally from Luoyang County, Henan, registered in a physician household of the Imperial Academy of Medicine, National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Tingguang, second in seniority, aged twenty-eight, born on the seventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhai Bochang (Principal Practitioner of the Medical School); his grandfather was Zhai Tan (Medical Secretary); his father is Zhai Guan (Imperial Physician); and his mother is née Pang. Both parents are living. He has an elder brother, Zhai Xuan (metropolitan graduate [jinshi]). He married née Yan, and remarried née Dong. He ranked 87th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 170th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Rong 徐容 (registered in a civilian household of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Wenliang, first in seniority, aged thirty-one, born on the first day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Fu; his grandfather was Xu Jizong; his father is Xu Yu; and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living. He has a younger brother, Xu Hong. He married née Zhang. He ranked 21st in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 187th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Li 楊理 (registered in a civilian household of Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], National University Student; specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Guanzhi, fifth in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Zongyuan; his grandfather was Yang Deqing; his father is Yang Kezhang; and his mother was née Liu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He has elder brothers Yang Qi, Yang Lin, Yang Lian, and Yang Xi, and a younger brother, Yang Zhen. He married née Jin. He ranked 47th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 299th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yuan 張淵 (originally from Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture, registered in a military household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zongben, second in seniority, aged thirty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Guying; his grandfather was Zhang Gongliang; his father was Zhang Hao; and his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He has an elder brother, Zhang Hai, and younger brothers Zhang Chun and Zhang Jun. He married née Yu. He ranked 8th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳岳〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字孟中，行三，年三十九，正月十三日生〕。曾祖士中〔贈監察御史〕；祖道潜〔監察御史〕；父公亮，嫡母余氏，生母許氏。具慶下，兄孟博、孟儼，娶張氏。福建鄉試第十四名，會試第一百二十六名。

江璞〔貫江西廣信府貴溪縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字伯溫，行六，年二十六，二月十八日生〕。曾祖應奎；祖雲從；父漢，前母張氏，母黃氏。慈侍下，兄琪、璘、玉、瑚、璉，娶周氏。江西鄉試第五名，會試第二百七十九名。

彭善〔貫江西吉安府安福縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字彥積，行十，年三十八，四月十六日生〕。曾祖伯樞；祖同升〔贈刑部主事〕；父進隣，母李氏。慈侍下，兄參和、參慶、參元，弟彥充〔禮部主事〕、華〔翰林編脩〕、禮、亶，娶歐陽氏。江西鄉試第四十二名，會試第八十五名。

柳琰〔貫直隸揚州府儀真縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字邦用，行二，年三十九，十月十七日生〕。曾祖仲得；祖裕；父讓，母朱氏。慈侍下，兄瑀，弟璸、琮、琨、珊，娶殷氏。應天府鄉試第十二名，會試第二百十三名。
translation_en:
Chen Yue 陳岳 (registered as a civilian householder of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Mengzhong 孟中; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine; born on the thirteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Chen Shizhong 士中 (posthumously honoured as Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Chen Daoqian 道潜 (Investigating Censor); his father is Chen Gongliang 公亮, his principal mother is Lady Yu 余氏, and his birth mother is Lady Xu 許氏. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Mengbo 孟博 and Mengyan 孟儼; he is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed 14th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Pu 江璞 (registered as a civilian householder of Guixi County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Bowen 伯溫; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six; born on the eighteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Jiang Yingkui 應奎; his grandfather was Jiang Yuncong 雲從; his father was Jiang Han 漢, his father's former wife was Lady Zhang 張氏, and his mother is Lady Huang 黃氏. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Qi 琪, Lin 璘, Yu 玉, Hu 瑚, and Lian 璉; he is married to Lady Zhou 周氏. He placed 5th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 279th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Shan 彭善 (registered as a civilian householder of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yanji 彥積; tenth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight; born on the sixteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Peng Boshu 伯樞; his grandfather was Peng Tongsheng 同升 (posthumously honoured as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his father was Peng Jinlin 進隣, and his mother is Lady Li 李氏. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Canhe 參和, Canqing 參慶, and Canyuan 參元, and his younger brothers are Yanchong 彥充 (Secretary in the Ministry of Rites), Hua 華 (Hanlin Historiographer), Li 禮, and Dan 亶; he is married to Lady Ouyang 歐陽氏. He placed 42nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 85th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yan 柳琰 (registered as a civilian householder of Yizhen County, Yangzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Metropolitan Area]; County School Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Bangyong 邦用; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine; born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Zhongde 仲得; his grandfather was Liu Yu 裕; his father was Liu Rang 讓, and his mother is Lady Zhu 朱氏. His mother is living; his elder brother is Yu 瑀, and his younger brothers are Bin 璸, Cong 琮, Kun 琨, and Shan 珊; he is married to Lady Yin 殷氏. He placed 12th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 213th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yu Jun 俞俊 (registered in an official household of the Yangzhou Guard 揚州衛 in the Directly Attached Region [Zhili 直隸], a student of the Jiangdu County 江都縣 School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing], courtesy name Shunqing 舜卿, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the fifteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yu Sizhong 思中; his grandfather was Yu Wenyou 文友; his father was Yu Yonggui 永貴 (Platoon Commander [Baihu]); his father's former wife was Lady Shang 尚氏; his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yu Qing 慶 (Platoon Commander) and Yu Ying 英; his younger brother is Yu Jie 傑. He married Lady Cui 崔氏. He ranked 68th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Wan 徐完 (registered in an official household of Jiangning County 江寧縣 in Yingtian Prefecture 應天府, a Directorate Student [Guozisheng], specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing], courtesy name Yongmei 用美, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yicheng 以誠; his grandfather was Xu Wenzhi 文質; his father is Xu Yu 昱 (Instructor [Zhujiao] in the Nanjing Directorate of Education [Nanjing Guozijian]); his mother is Lady Gu 顧氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xu Pu 溥 and Xu Jun 浚; his younger brothers are Xu Kuan 寬 and Xu Tai 泰. He married Lady Jin 金氏. He ranked 34th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 44th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Yu 吳玉 (registered in a civilian household of Neijiang County 內江縣 in Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川, a Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Tingxian 廷獻, third in seniority among brothers, aged forty-one, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Shengyuan 勝淵; his grandfather was Wu Xian 賢 (Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier [Gongshi]); his father was Wu Zhongxing 仲性; his mother was Lady Gan 甘氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Wu Xuan 㬂 and Wu Ang 昻; his younger brothers are Wu Xun 遜 and Wu Dao 道. He married Lady Zhu 祝氏. He ranked 50th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 47th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhan Yu 詹雨 (registered in a civilian household of Songyang County 松陽縣 in Chuzhou Prefecture 處州府, Zhejiang 浙江, a county school student, specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Tianze 天澤, sixth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the fifth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhan Junqi 鈞玘; his grandfather was Zhan Guofang 國方; his father was Zhan Jingwei 景威 (Assistant Magistrate [Zhubu]); his father's former wife was Lady Zhang 張氏; his mother is Lady Yi 廙氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhan Dao 燾, Zhan Hao 皞, Zhan Shou 壽, Zhan Hai 海, and Zhan Lun 輪; his younger brother is Zhan Bao 寶. He married Lady Jin 金氏. He ranked 7th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 37th in the Metropolitan Examination.

陸淵之〔貫浙江紹興府上虞縣人，留守中衛軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字克深，行四，年二十三，八月二十九日生〕。曾祖仲彰，祖士衡，父全〔倉副使〕，母周氏。慈侍下。兄義之〔譯字官〕、信之、浩之。娶周氏。順天府鄉試第一百二名，會試第二名。

畢用〔貫山東兖州府鉅野縣人，遼東定遼前衛官籍，武生，治《書經》，字廷用，行一，年二十五，十一月初二日生〕。曾祖通，祖隆，父清，母喬氏，繼母完氏。具慶下。聘張氏。山東鄉試第六十四名，會試第一百六名。

林鳳〔貫浙江温州府樂清縣人，錦衣衛官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字應道，行一，年二十七，十月初六日生〕。曾祖子俊，祖茂，父巒〔錦衣衛百户〕，母張氏。具慶下。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第四十六名，會試第九十七名。

李錦〔貫狹西西安府涇陽縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字尚絅，行四，年三十四，十一月二十六日生〕。曾祖清甫，祖秉中，父思繹，母潘氏。慈侍下。兄視遠、視明〔聽選官〕、視誠。娶曹氏。狹西鄉試第八十四名，會試第五十四名。
translation_en:
Lu Yuanzhi 陸淵之 (a native of Shangyu County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a military household of the Central Regency Guard; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Keshen, fourth in seniority, aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Lu Zhongzhang; his grandfather was Lu Shiheng; his father was Lu Quan (Granary Vice Commissioner); and his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Lu Yizhi (Translator), Lu Xinzhi, and Lu Haozhi. He married née Zhou. He placed 102nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 2nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bi Yong 畢用 (a native of Juye County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, registered in an official household of the Dingliao Vanguard Guard in Liaodong; a Military Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingyong, first in seniority, aged twenty-five, born on the second day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Bi Tong; his grandfather was Bi Long; his father is Bi Qing; his mother was née Qiao; and his stepmother is née Wan. Both his father and stepmother are living. He is betrothed to née Zhang. He placed 64th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 106th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Feng 林鳳 (a native of Yueqing County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in an official household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yingdao, first in seniority, aged twenty-seven, born on the sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Zijun; his grandfather was Lin Mao; his father is Lin Luan (Company Commander in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); and his mother is née Zhang. Both parents are living. He married née Wang. He placed 46th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 97th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jin 李錦 (registered in a civilian household of Jingyang County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shangjiong, fourth in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Li Qingfu; his grandfather was Li Bingzhong; his father was Li Siyi; and his mother is née Pan. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Shiyuan, Li Shiming (Expectant Official), and Li Shicheng. He married née Cao. He placed 84th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 54th in the Metropolitan Examination.

黃仲昭〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，府學增廣生，治《詩經》，字仲昭，行二，年三十二，二月二十七日生〕。曾祖文圭〔封工部主事〕；祖壽生〔檢討，贈知縣〕；父子嘉〔知縣〕；母鄭氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下。兄深〔監察御史〕。娶羅氏。福建鄉試第六名，會試第一百七十九名。

謝文祥〔貫湖廣衡州府耒陽縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元吉，行五，年三十四，十月十四日生〕。曾祖仲和；祖永昌；父必賢〔知州〕；前母劉氏、蕭氏；母楊氏。永感下。兄文泰、文善〔貢士〕、文漢、文憲。娶李氏。湖廣鄉試第二十八名，會試第五十三名。

戴縉〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子容，行一，年四十，一月十二日生〕。曾祖濟；祖以信；父璉〔訓導〕；母李氏。永感下。弟紘〔舉人〕、絙〔舉人〕、紳。娶周氏。廣東鄉試第三十一名，會試第三百一名。

葉廷榮〔貫浙江台州府臨海縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字尚本，行三，年三十一，十月十六日生〕。曾祖文禮；祖孝先〔贈刑部主事〕；父恩〔前知府〕；嫡母龔氏〔封安人〕；生母畢氏。具慶下。兄最、蔭；弟碩、華、森。娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第二十七名，會試第一百二十名。
translation_en:
Huang Zhongzhao 黃仲昭: Registered in a civilian household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; an added student (zengguangsheng) of the prefectural school, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongzhao 仲昭, second in generational order, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-seventh day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Wengui 文圭 (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Works); his grandfather was Shousheng 壽生 (Examining Editor, posthumously invested as District Magistrate); his father is Zijia 子嘉 (District Magistrate); his mother is née Zheng 鄭氏 (invested as Child Nurturess). Both parents are living. His elder brother is Shen 深 (Investigating Censor); he is married to née Luo 羅氏. He ranked sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Wenxiang 謝文祥: Registered in a military household of Leiyang County 耒陽縣, Hengzhou Prefecture 衡州府, Huguang 湖廣; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanji 元吉, fifth in generational order, aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Zhonghe 仲和; his grandfather was Yongchang 永昌; his father was Bixian 必賢 (Department Magistrate); his father's former wives were née Liu 劉氏 and née Xiao 蕭氏; his mother was née Yang 楊氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Wentai 文泰, Wenshan 文善 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), Wenhan 文漢, and Wenxian 文憲; he is married to née Li 李氏. He ranked twenty-eighth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Jin 戴縉: Registered in a civilian household of Nanhai County 南海縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zirong 子容, first in generational order, aged forty, born on the twelfth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Ji 濟; his grandfather was Yixin 以信; his father was Lian 璉 (Assistant Instructor); his mother was née Li 李氏. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Hong 紘 (provincial graduate [juren]), Geng 絙 (provincial graduate [juren]), and Shen 紳; he is married to née Zhou 周氏. He ranked thirty-first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and three hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Tingrong 葉廷榮: Registered in a civilian household of Linhai County 臨海縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shangben 尚本, third in generational order, aged thirty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wenli 文禮; his grandfather was Xiaoxian 孝先 (posthumously invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his father is En 恩 (former Prefect); his legal mother is née Gong 龔氏 (invested as Mistress of Peace); his birth mother is née Bi 畢氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zui 最 and Yin 蔭; his younger brothers are Shuo 碩, Hua 華, and Sen 森; he is married to née Chen 陳氏. He ranked twenty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Lin Fu 林敷 [registered in a civilian household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Congkuan; twelfth in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-seven; born on the second day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Zongda; his grandfather was Lin Zhen; his father was Lin Tingfang [District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father's former wives were Lady Zheng and Lady Yang; his mother is Lady Shi. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brothers are Lin Dun, Lin Zheng, Lin Qi [Investigating Censor (jiancha yushi)], Lin Jing, and Lin Gan. He married Lady Wang. He placed sixty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Yu 鄭昱 [registered in a civilian household of Changshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shihui; second in seniority among his brothers; age forty; born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Junbao; his grandfather was Zheng Zhao; his father is Zheng Gongmian [Assistant District Magistrate (xiancheng)]; his mother was Lady Jiang. His father is living (yanshixia). His elder brother is Zheng Huang, and his younger brothers are Zheng Sheng, Zheng Jiong, Zheng Bing, Zheng Ang, and Zheng Gao. He married Lady Yu. He placed twenty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Min 張敏 [originally of Qingjiang County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered in a military household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei); Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhixue; first in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-six; born on the tenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Jirong; his grandfather is Zhang Wenzhi; his father is Zhang Yishi; his mother is Lady Wang. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). He married Lady Hu. He placed tenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Pu 楊溥 [originally of Ye County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong, registered in a military household of the Dezhou Left Guard in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Subprefectural Student (zhouxuesheng); specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Gongpu; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-one; born on the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Keren; his grandfather was Yang Boyuan; his father is Yang Sheng; his mother is Lady Lü. Both of his parents are living (juqingxia). He married Lady Han. He placed fifth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Jiusi 徐九思 (registered in a civilian household of Deqing County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yiqing; third in seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Juyi, his grandfather was Xu Du, his father is Xu Tingmo, and his mother is née Jiang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Xu Jiuling and Xu Jiuding, and his younger brothers are Xu Jiucheng and Xu Jiuwan. He married née Wang. He ranked 4th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 199th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Weixue 薛爲學 (registered in a civilian household of Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhiyuan; first in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the eleventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Xue Haozhi, his grandfather was Xue Xixian, his father is Xue Xuan, and his mother is née Shi. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Xue Chengxue, Xue Jinxue, Xue Xingxue, and Xue Laixue. He married née Jin. He ranked 26th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 283rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Rong 李瑢 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingzhang; seventh in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Li Bokui (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Minister), his grandfather was Li Zunwu (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Minister), his father is Li Shao (Right Vice Minister of Rites), and his mother was née Zeng (posthumously honoured as Lady of Virtue). His father is living. His elder brothers are Li Xiang and Li Qi (a National University Student), and his younger brothers are Li Lian, Li Chen, and Li Fan. He married née Liu. He ranked 82nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 277th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Guan 諸觀 (registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Confucian Scholar specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Minzhan; fourth in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the third day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Runqing, his grandfather was Zhu Zhongde, his father is Zhu Mengwu, and his mother was née Xiang. His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhu Cong, Zhu Xiao, and Zhu Lun. He married née Xu. He ranked 41st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 139th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Dai Xi 戴僖 (registered in a civilian household of Yongxin County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Dajie, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Dai Jingquan, his grandfather was Dai Wenyan, his father was Dai Duhu, his father's first wife was née Zhou, his mother was née Xie, and his stepmother is née Long. His mother (or stepmother) is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Dai Ti and Dai Chou, his younger brother is Dai Fen, and he is married to née Long. He ranked 38th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Gao 張誥 (registered in a civilian household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Directly Attached [Zhili]; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Ruqin, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-third day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Tianyou, his grandfather was Zhang Zhongqing, his father is Zhang Xun, and his mother is née Jin. Both of his parents are living. He is married to née Xie. He ranked 111th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 337th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bi Yu 畢瑜 (registered in a military household of Guixi County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Tingzhen, nineteenth in seniority in his generation, aged thirty-one, born on the first day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Bi Yifang, his grandfather was Bi Dexing, his father was Bi Yuan (a Student of the Directorate of Education), his father's first wife was née Weng, and his mother is née Li. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Bi Jin, Bi Lin, Bi Lian, and Bi Pu, and he is married to née Fang. He ranked 19th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 48th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yu 張玉 (registered in a civilian household of Wuqiao County, Jing Subprefecture, Hejian Prefecture, Directly Attached [Zhili]; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tingzan, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the first day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Shineng, his grandfather was Zhang Xiang (Associate Salt Distribution Commissioner), his father was Zhang Ben, and his mother is née Xu. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Zhang Zhen, Zhang Xuan, Zhang Guan, Zhang Hu, Zhang Huan, and Zhang Ju, and he is married to née Zhou. He ranked 233rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 262nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Yuyi 劉育衣 [person from Yongxin County 永新縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西, registered in a military household of the Jinan Guard 濟南衛, Shandong 山東; National University Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu 春秋); courtesy name Zongfang 總芳, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month (or aged thirty, born on the二十sixth day of the twelfth month; note: 劉禔 [transcribed here as 劉育衣], courtesy name 總芳 [likely OCR for 德芳])]. His great-grandfather was Liu Weijing 惟敬; his grandfather was Liu Jun 鈞; his father was Liu Jun 儁, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Liu Lu 祿, and his younger brother is Liu Chi 褫. He married a woman née Pan 潘氏. He placed 49th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 347th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Yao 趙瑤 [registered in a military household of Jinjiang County 晉江縣, Quanzhou Prefecture 泉州府, Fujian 福建; Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng 府學生) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji 禮記); courtesy name Deyong 德用, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Yongneng 永能; his grandfather was Zhao Bingyang 秉陽; his father was Zhao Tinghuan 廷煥, and his mother was née Lin 林氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zhao Xian 憲, and his younger brothers are Zhao Liang 亮, Zhao Yin 寅, and Zhao Fu 輔. He married a woman née Zhang 張氏. He placed 1st in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 134th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Menghe 林孟和 [registered in a civilian household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Ruhe 汝和, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Chongde 崇德; his grandfather was Lin Tixun 體遜; his father is Lin Xuan 瑄 [Instructor (jiaoyu 教諭)], and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Lin Zhongyun 仲允, Lin Zhongxi 仲熹, Lin Xu 煦, and Lin Gongzhi 公治. He married a woman née Zheng 鄭氏, and took as his second wife a woman née Weng 翁氏. He placed 42nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 7th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Jingzhao 魏景釗 [registered in a civilian household of Dong'an County 東安縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Dayong 大用, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the first day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wei Liang 良; his grandfather was Wei Zheng 整; his father is Wei Zhongshi 仲實, his mother was née Zhang 張氏, and his stepmother is née Cao 曹氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. He married a woman née Zhang 張氏. He placed 62nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 330th in the Metropolitan Examination.

劉策〔貫順天府大興縣人，廣西桂林中衛軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字尚謨，行三，年二十七，十一月十一日生〕。曾祖慶；祖端；父俊；母傅氏。具慶下。兄本〔同科進士〕、立〔義官〕；弟昱。娶吳氏。廣西鄉試第十六名，會試第七十名。

translation_en:
Pang Chang 龐常 (registered in a civilian household of Luzhou 瀘州, Sichuan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Bingyi 秉彞; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Pang Junyu 均郁; his grandfather was Pang Degui 德貴; his father was Pang Ren 仁 (Public-spirited Civilian); his father's former wife was née Zhu 朱氏; his mother was née He 何氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Pang Fu 福, Pang Lu 祿, and Pang Ji 濟; his younger brothers are Pang Liang 良 and Pang Cheng 澄. He married née Shi 史氏. He ranked thirtieth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mei Yu 梅愈 (registered in a civilian household of Hukou County 湖口縣, Jiujiang Prefecture 九江府, Jiangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zonghan 宗韓; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twelfth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Mei Shou'er 壽二; his grandfather was Mei Zhihe 志和; his father is Mei Qing 清; his father's former wife was née Fang 方氏; his mother is née Cao 曹氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Mei Mao 懋, Mei Cong 聰, and Mei Qing 慶. He married née Xie 謝氏. He ranked sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ce 劉策 (a native of Daxing County 大興縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府, registered in a military household of the Guilin Central Guard 桂林中衛 in Guangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shangmo 尚謨; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Qing 慶; his grandfather was Liu Duan 端; his father is Liu Jun 俊; his mother is née Fu 傅氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Ben 本 (metropolitan graduate of the same class) and Liu Li 立 (Public-spirited Official); his younger brother is Liu Yu 昱. He married née Wu 吳氏. He ranked sixteenth in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Tinglian 陳廷璉 (registered in a military household of You County 攸縣, Changsha Prefecture 長沙府, Huguang; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zongqi 宗器; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Shouqing 壽卿; his grandfather is Chen Dexin 德新 (National University Student); his father is Chen Jian 鑑 (Prefectural Instructor of Medicine); his mother is née Peng 彭氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Tinggui 廷珪 (Tribute Student) and Chen Tingzhang 廷璋; his younger brothers are Chen Tingmao 廷瑁 (Tribute Student), Chen Tingyao 廷瑤, Chen Tingguan 廷瓘, and Chen Tingsui 廷璲. He is betrothed to née Lan 蘭氏. He ranked eighteenth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and three hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Xiu 張岫 (registered in a civilian household of Anyi County, Xiezhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student at the Hedong Salt Distribution Commission School; specialized in the Book of Documents; courtesy name Jiuyun; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Conggu, his grandfather was Zhang Lidao, his father was Zhang Qi (District Magistrate), and his mother is née Lü. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Zhang Yi, Zhang Lan, and Zhang Yue. He married a woman née Sun. He placed thirty-first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zongyi 王宗彞 (registered in a military household of Shulu County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; County Student; specialized in the Book of Odes; courtesy name Biaolun; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Bi, his grandfather was Wang Xu, his father was Wang Wen, and his mother was née Zhao. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Wang Jing, Wang Yuan, Wang Zhong, and Wang Chen, and his younger brother is Wang Zongbi. He married a woman née Feng. He placed thirty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Wenhuan 朱文環 (registered in a civilian household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Confucian Scholar; specialized in the Book of Odes; courtesy name Wenpei; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twelfth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Lu, his grandfather was Zhu Tianbao, his father is Zhu Shiyuan, and his mother is née Weng. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Zhu Wenlin. He married a woman née Zeng, and took as his second wife a woman née Chen. He placed thirty-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lao Pin 勞玭 (registered in a civilian household of Chongde County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Odes; courtesy name Ruming; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the seventh day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Lao Junrang, his grandfather was Lao Yangang, his father was Lao Tingfang, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Lao Rusheng, and his younger brother is Lao Ruliang. He married a woman née Ling. He placed eighty-third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Yingkui 宋應奎 [registered in an official household of Jishui County 吉水縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Erzhang 爾章; first in seniority; age thirty-three, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Song Ruojing 若景 [posthumously honored as Administrator (zhangshi)], his grandfather was Song Zihuan 子環 [metropolitan graduate (jinshi), Director of a Bureau (langzhong) in the Ministry of Personnel], his father was Song Huai 懷 [metropolitan graduate (jinshi), Chief Minister (qing) of the Seal Office], and his mother is née Hu 胡 [invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Yingbi 應璧 and Yingzhen 應禎, and he married née Zhou 周. He placed 193rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 239th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Yin 吳禋 [registered in a military household of Lingling County 零陵縣, Yongzhou Prefecture 永州府, Huguang 湖廣; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Kecheng 克誠; seventh in seniority; age thirty-six, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Yun 雲, his grandfather was Wu Zhongyun 仲允, his father was Wu Zheng 政, and his mother was née Huang 黃. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Zhen 禎, Xiang 祥, You 祐, Qi 祺, Xi 禧, and Yu 裕, and he married née Zuo 左. He placed 58th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 227th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Both parents are living. His elder brother is Tingguang 廷廣, and his younger brother is Liangfu 良輔. He married Lady Jiang 蔣氏, and subsequently married Lady Qi 齊氏. Luo Xinjia 羅信佳 (registered in a civilian household of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bangyan 邦彥; fourteenth in his generation; age forty, born on the eighteenth day of the second month). Pan Zhen 潘禎 (registered in a civilian household of Tiantai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Directorate [Student] specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Yingchang 應昌; first in his generation; age thirty-two, [born in] the sixth month [four characters illegible]). His great-grandfather was Pan Shu'an 叔安; his grandfather was Pan Bozhuang 伯莊; his father is Pan Wei 偉 (Prefectural Instructor); and his mother is Lady Zhang 張氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xiang 祥, Ji 禨, and Qi 祺. He married Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed 13th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 214th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Chen Sijing 思敬; his grandfather was Chen Gongding 公鼎; his father is Chen Ruxian 汝賢 (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); and his mother is Lady Gu 顧氏 (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both parents are living. His elder brother is Lan 蘭 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner), and his younger brothers are Xun 薰 (Public-spirited Officer [yiguan]) and Yun 芸. He married Lady Xue 薛氏, and subsequently married Lady Duan 段氏. He placed 53rd in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 73rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

張海〔貫山東濟南府德州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文淵，行二，年三十一，五月十二日生〕。曾祖義；祖鵬舉；父忠；母李氏。慈侍下。兄潡、洋，弟江、瀾。娶潘氏。山東鄉試第一名，會試第八名。
translation_en:
Zhou Han 周翰 (registered in a civilian household of Chongren County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Liangbi; second in generational seniority; aged twenty, born on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Taiqian; his grandfather was Gongfu; his father is Bangxian; his mother is née Yuan. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Liangqi, and his younger brothers are Liangfu and Liangzai. He married a woman née Yu. He ranked 23rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Qi 曾麒 (registered in a military household of Le'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Xiangzhao; first in generational seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Luzhan; his grandfather was Yiguang; his father was Junde; his mother was née Nie. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Xianggong. He married [two characters illegible]. He ranked 76th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 69th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wan Xiu 萬繡 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals; courtesy name Gongjin; sixteenth in generational seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the [illegible] day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Qiwu (a Police Chief under the Yuan); his grandfather was Jing'an; his father was Ji (a metropolitan graduate [jinshi] and District Magistrate); his mother was née Liu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Ji, Gang, Lian, and Ji, and his younger brother is Yi. He married a woman née Wang. He ranked 31st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 219th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Hai 張海 (registered in a civilian household of Dezhou Department, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Wenyuan; second in generational seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the twelfth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Yi; his grandfather was Pengju; his father was Zhong; his mother is née Li. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Dun and Yang, and his younger brothers are Jiang and Lan. He married a woman née Pan. He ranked 1st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 8th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Qi Zhang 齊章 (from Luanzhou 灤州 in Yongping Prefecture 永平府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; registered in an official household of the Yanshan Left Guard 燕山左衛; a student of the Directorate of Education 國子生 specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yingbi 應璧; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Qi Jinzhong 進中; his grandfather was Qi Gui 貴 (posthumously honoured as Assistant Guard Commander 指揮僉事); his father is Qi An 安 (Assistant Guard Commander); and his mother is Lady Guo 郭氏 (invested as Respectable Lady 恭人). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Qi Wen 文 (tribute student 貢士) and Qi Duan 端. He married Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed ninety-seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Qifan 余祈繁 (registered in a military household in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; an added student of the county school 縣學增廣生 specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rusheng 汝盛; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Shiyan 士彥; his grandfather was Yu Zhonggong 仲恭; his father is Yu Cunli 存理; and his mother is Lady Wu 吳氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Yu Qihua 祈華. He married [two characters illegible]. He placed sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Gao 金臯 (from Wujiang County 吳江縣 in Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; registered in a military artisan household of the Wugong Central Guard 武功中衛; a student of the Directorate of Education 國子生 specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Gongqi 公器; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born in the second month [four characters illegible]). His great-grandfather was Jin Siweng 四翁; his grandfather was Jin Zhongming 仲銘; his father was Jin Fucheng 福成; and his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Jin Ding 鼎 and Jin Nai 鼐; his younger brother is Jin Zeng 增. He married Lady Xian 鮮氏. He placed fifty-first in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fu 王輔 (from Haiyan County 海鹽縣 in Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江; registered in a military household of the Guangning Left Tun Guard 廣寧左屯衛 in Liaodong 遼東; a student of the Directorate of Education 國子生 specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shizuo 時佐; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Junqing 俊卿; his grandfather was Wang Wenzhi 文智; his father was Wang Cong 聰; his principal mother was Lady Ni 倪氏; and his birth mother is Lady Huang 黃氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brother is Wang Xuan 宣. He married Lady Wu 吳氏. He placed third in the Shandong 山東 Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Jun 談俊 [registered in a civilian household of Deqing County 德清縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江; County Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiying 時英; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Tan Wenli 文禮; his grandfather was Tan Sizhong 思忠 [recipient of honorary cap and belt]; his father is Tan Yancheng 彥誠; and his mother is Lady Wei 魏氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Tan Jie 傑, Tan Lun 倫, and Tan Ren 仁; he married Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed 28th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 315th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Zhuang 徐莊 [registered in a civilian household of Shouchang County 壽昌縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Jingfu 敬夫; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Shan 善; his grandfather was Xu Deming 德銘 [District Magistrate]; his father was Xu Zhi'ang 志昂; and his mother is Lady Fan 范氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Xu Jin 覲, and his younger brothers are Xu Weng 甕 [tribute student (gongshi)], Xu Zi 鼒, Xu Chong 茺, Xu Chou 薵, Xu Dan 萏, and Xu Shun 蕣; he married Lady Mao 毛氏, and took as his second wife [?]氏. He placed 84th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 27th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Zhang Zaizhong 在中; his grandfather was Zhang Runfang 潤芳 [posthumously honored as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Works]; his father is Zhang Xuan 璿 [Left Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Works]; and his mother is Lady Ma 馬氏 [invested as Child Nurturer (ruren)]. His elder brothers are Zhang Xuan 鉉 [Directorate Student] and Zhang Hong 鋐, and his younger brothers are Zhang Huan 鍰, Zhang Bing 鉼, Zhang Chun 錞, Zhang Hao 鎬, Zhang Liu 鏐, Zhang Song 鎹, Zhang Han 釬, and Zhang Zhen 鎮; he married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed 10th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 190th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kong Ju 孔舉 [registered in a civilian household of Shucheng County 舒城縣, Luzhou Prefecture 廬州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shunqing 舜卿; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the tenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Kong Xiwen 希文 [Assistant Instructor in a Medical School]; his grandfather was Kong Xun 詢; his father is Kong Xiao 斆; and his mother is Lady Zong 宗氏. 陳琦〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣人，太醫院籍，醫生，治《詩經》，字粹之，行二，年二十八，二月初九日生〕。曾祖孚敏；祖紀；父茂；母錢氏，繼母張氏。具慶下。兄琳；弟瑄。娶吳氏。順天府鄉試第十二名，會試第五十二名。

方輅〔貫浙江嘉興府平湖縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字洪載，行三，年三十四，八月二十四日生〕。曾祖大有；祖敬；父寬；母沈氏。具慶下。兄瓛、珙；弟瑢。娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第五十六名，會試第二百八十五名。
translation_en:
Wei Bing 魏秉, registered in a commoner household in Pucheng County, Hua Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, was a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); his courtesy name was Zhizhong, he was fourth in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-five sui old, born on the twenty-second day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Wei Shilian; his grandfather was Wei Zongrang; his father was Wei Zhen; and his mother was née Ru. Both of his parents were living. His elder brothers were Wei An, Wei Heng, and Wei Xiang; his younger brothers were Wei Ting, Wei Tai, and Wei Shan; and he was married to née Lü. He placed fifty-first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Xishuo 傅希說, registered in a commoner household in Wucheng County, Gaotang Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong, was a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); his courtesy name was Shangzuo, he was first in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-five sui old, born on the twenty-third day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Fu Jingxiang; his grandfather was Fu Shigang; his father was Fu Chun; his mother was née Li, and his stepmother was née Liu. His father and stepmother were both living. His younger brother was Fu Xijun, and he was married to née Yu. He placed seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and three hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Qi 陳琦, a native of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered in an Imperial Academy of Medicine (Taiyiyuan) household, was a Medical Student (yisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name was Cuizhi, he was second in seniority among his brothers, and he was twenty-eight sui old, born on the ninth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Chen Fumin; his grandfather was Chen Ji; his father was Chen Mao; his mother was née Qian, and his stepmother was née Zhang. His father and stepmother were both living. His elder brother was Chen Lin; his younger brother was Chen Xuan; and he was married to née Wu. He placed twelfth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Lu 方輅, registered in a commoner household in Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); his courtesy name was Hongzai, he was third in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-four sui old, born on the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Fang Dayou; his grandfather was Fang Jing; his father was Fang Kuan; and his mother was née Shen. Both of his parents were living. His elder brothers were Fang Huan and Fang Gong; his younger brother was Fang Rong; and he was married to née Yang. He placed fifty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

江泝〔貫福建建寧府建安縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字本達，行一，年三十九，七月十八日生〕。曾祖昇；祖貞〔給事中〕；父鏞，母李氏。永感下。娶劉氏。應天府鄉試第十七名，會試第三百四十九名。

劉鎡〔貫江西吉安府安福縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字伏時，行十，年三十七，七月初五日生〕。曾祖子定；祖伯文〔贈禮部主事〕；父求矩，母王氏。永感下。兄鉞〔建寧府知府〕、鎬、銳〔國子學錄〕、鈺〔按察司副使〕、銑、鏞，弟鏡、欽。娶王氏。江西鄉試第五十八名，會試第一百三十二名。

劉瑀〔貫直隸保定府蠡縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝器，行六，年三十六，四月十二日生〕。曾祖福覺；祖士美；父亨〔典史〕，母李氏。慈侍下。兄政、俊、璿、璣、琮。娶楊氏。順天府鄉試第七十四名，會試第三百十名。
translation_en:
Wang Jin 王進, registered in a commoner household in Shangyu County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Jinchen, he was the tenth in seniority among his male peers in the family, and he was thirty-two sui, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Shanqing; his grandfather was Wang Youzhi; his father was Wang Tao, and his mother was née He. His father was living and his mother deceased. His elder brothers were Wang Da, Wang Sui, Wang Jiong, Wang Shu, and Wang Shi. He was married to a woman née Pan. He placed 71st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 321st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Su 江泝, registered in a commoner household in Jian'an County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian, was a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His courtesy name was Benda, he was the first in seniority among his male peers in the family, and he was thirty-nine sui, born on the eighteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Jiang Sheng; his grandfather was Jiang Zhen, a Supervising Secretary (jishizhong); his father was Jiang Yong, and his mother was née Li. Both of his parents were deceased. He was married to a woman née Liu. He placed 17th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 349th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zi 劉鎡, registered in a commoner household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, was a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His courtesy name was Fushi, he was the tenth in seniority among his male peers in the family, and he was thirty-seven sui, born on the fifth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Liu Ziding; his grandfather was Liu Bowen, posthumously honored as a Secretary in the Ministry of Rites (Libu zhushi); his father was Liu Qiuju, and his mother was née Wang. Both of his parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Liu Yue, Prefect (zhifu) of Jianning Prefecture; Liu Hao; Liu Rui, Registrar in the Directorate of Education (guozi xuelu); Liu Yu, Surveillance Vice Commissioner (anchasi fushi); Liu Xian; and Liu Yong; his younger brothers were Liu Jing and Liu Qin. He was married to a woman née Wang. He placed 58th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 132nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yu 劉瑀, registered in a commoner household in Li County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili, was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Ruqi, he was the sixth in seniority among his male peers in the family, and he was thirty-six sui, born on the twelfth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Fujue; his grandfather was Liu Shimei; his father was Liu Heng, an Unclassified Jail Warden (dianshi), and his mother was née Li. His mother was living and his father deceased. His elder brothers were Liu Zheng, Liu Jun, Liu Xuan, Liu Ji, and Liu Cong. He was married to a woman née Yang. He placed 74th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 310th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Jing 張靜: Registered in a military household in Pengshan County, Meizhou, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Anzhi, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Biwang, his grandfather was Siming, his father is Yifang, and his mother was née Deng. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Yongzhi, Yinzhi, Xiangzhi, Weizhi, and Danzhi. He married née Li. He placed sixteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 172nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Zheng 魏政: A native of Xi'an County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a military household of the Taiyuan Front Guard in Shanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yide, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Bo'an, his grandfather was Zhen, his father is Neng, and his mother is née Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Di, Jiao, and Lian. He married née Zhang. He placed twentieth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Chun 何淳: Registered in a civilian household in Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shangzhi, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Yu, his grandfather was Sidao, his father is Changtong, and his mother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zu'en and Zurang, and his younger brother is Zucheng. He married née Shao. He placed second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

You Zuo 游佐: Registered in a civilian household in Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Rubi, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the sixteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Wenrui, his grandfather was Yuxian, his father was Di, and his mother is née Lu. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Jiong, Fang (Postal Relay Station Master), and Ming. He married née Luo. He placed thirteenth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 259th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Hu Tianshou, his grandfather was Hu Deyi, his father is Hu Yongzhong, and his mother is Lady Wu. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Hu Rong, Hu Gui, Hu Yue, and Hu Zhi. He married Lady Wang, and remarried Lady Liang. He placed 170th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 228th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Han 朱漢 [registered in a civilian household of Gao'an County, Ruizhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jingyun; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Shigu, his grandfather was Zhu Mengzhan, his father is Zhu Shangjie, and his mother is Lady Tang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhu Hai, Zhu Yuan, and Zhu Pu, and his younger brother is Zhu Yuan. He married Lady Yang. He placed 79th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 169th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Chang 孫敞 [registered in a civilian household of Anqiu County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yizhi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the fifth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Gongmei, his grandfather was Sun Shixian, his father was Sun Fu, and his mother is Lady Gao. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Sun Tai and Sun Tong. He married Lady Zhang. He placed 52nd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 121st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Long 蕭龍 [registered in a civilian household of Chaoyang County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiao Guichen, his grandfather was Xiao Shilin, his father was Xiao Jingrui, and his mother is Lady Fan. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Xiao Qing [National University Student], Xiao Qi [𤨒], Xiao Yu, Xiao Bi, Xiao Xi, Xiao Yong [壅?], Xiao Yu, Xiao You, and Xiao Lu. He married Lady Zheng. He placed 54th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 267th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Yi 章鎰: A native of Yin County, Zhejiang, registered in a wealthy household (fuhu) in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture. A National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Yuanyi, he is fifth in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-six sui, born on the eighth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Lirong, his grandfather was Zhang Jie, his father is Zhang Jing, and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Zhang Qi, Zhang Rong, and Zhang Rui; his younger brothers are Zhang Duo, Zhang Quan, Zhang Xian, Zhang Ju, Zhang Jian, Zhang Kai, Zhang Zhao, Zhang Ming, and Zhang Yue. He married née Yuan. He placed fifty-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Guan 李觀: Native domicile in Yongjia County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, of military household registration (junji). A National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Shirong, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is forty sui, born on the eighth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Li Wenbin, his grandfather was Li Jingxin, his father is Li Lian, and his mother was née Zhou. His father is living and his mother is deceased (yanshi xia). His younger brothers are Li Jian, Li Lun, Li Lin, Li Zuo, and Li Yi. He married née Lin. He placed fortieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Chun 何純: Native domicile in Xingan County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi, of civilian household registration (minji). An Added Student (zengguang sheng) of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Weiyi, he is fourth in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-three sui, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was He Wurong, his grandfather was He Zichong, his father is He Zhen (invested with the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), and his mother is née Tu (invested as Lady of Serenity). Both parents are living. His elder brothers are He Xian, He Zhong (Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice), He Shan, and He Xiang; his younger brothers are He Jing, He Liang, He Neng, and He She. He married née Chen. He placed eighteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jian 劉簡: Native domicile in Fushun County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan, of civilian household registration. A National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), his courtesy name is Weiyan, he is second in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-six sui, born on the tenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Tingrui, his grandfather was Liu Sigong, his father is Liu Jun, and his mother is née Zhu. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Su. He married née Hu. He placed thirty-eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and three hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Zhao and Sheng, and his younger brothers are Ang and Hao. He married Lady Zhu, and was subsequently betrothed to Lady Chu. He ranked fifty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Chun 柳淳 [registered in a military household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Wencui; first in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the eighth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather is Demao, his grandfather is Yong, his father is Qiong, and his mother is Lady Yuan. Both parents are living. He married Lady Fan. He ranked sixty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Song 高崧 [registered in a civilian household in Xiangcheng County, Xuzhou Subprefecture, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongxiu; first in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather is Cai, his grandfather is Zheng, his father is Liang, and his mother is Lady Li. His mother is living and his father is deceased; his younger brothers are Yue, Yan, and Chong. He married Lady Zhang. He ranked thirty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Shirong 吳世榮 [registered in a civilian household in Lishui County, Chuzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Keren; second in his generation; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather is Shidao, his grandfather is Mian [District Magistrate], his father is Chen [Administrator], and his mother is Lady Shen. His mother is living and his father is deceased; his elder brother is Shi'an. He married Lady Zhou. He ranked sixteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

治易經字有終行四年二十八五月初一日生
曾祖忠　祖誠　父鳳　母陳氏
具慶下　兄豫　臨　泰　頤　弟觀　娶李氏
順天府鄉試第一百十六名　會試第一百八十名
punctuated:
顧福〔貫直隸吳縣人，順天府大興縣匠籍，府學增廣生，治《詩經》，字天錫，行三，年二十七，五月十四日生〕。曾祖仁達；祖忠；父賢〔封光祿寺署丞〕；母陶氏〔封孺人〕。慈侍下。兄禎〔光祿寺署丞〕、祥；弟祿。娶李氏。順天府鄉試第六十五名，會試第一百七十三名。

徐恪〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字公肅，行八，年三十六，十二月初十日生〕。曾祖伯皐；祖孟明；父敏叔；嫡母周氏；生母張氏。慈侍下。兄慎、愷、悌、懷、恜〔知縣〕、懌、悛。娶許氏。應天府鄉試第十二名，會試第三百四十八名。

周原學〔貫湖廣黃州府蘄州廣濟縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字希古，行四，年三十九，七月十五日生〕。曾祖叔達；祖記賢；父思敬〔訓導〕；母李氏。永感下。兄原啓、原廣、原善、原聰、原通。娶田氏。湖廣鄉試第二名，會試第七十八名。

蕭謙〔貫四川重慶府巴縣人，直隸永平衛軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字有終，行四，年二十八，五月初一日生〕。曾祖忠；祖誠；父鳳；母陳氏。具慶下。兄豫、臨、泰、頤；弟觀。娶李氏。順天府鄉試第一百十六名，會試第一百八十名。
translation_en:
Gu Fu 顧福 (ancestral home Wu County, Southern Metropolitan Area; registered in an artisan household in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture; Added Student of the prefectural school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tianxi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven; born on the fourteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Gu Renda; his grandfather was Gu Zhong; his father was Gu Xian (granted the title of Aide in a Service of the Court of Imperial Entertainments); and his mother is née Tao (granted the title of Child Nurturess). His mother is living. His elder brothers are Gu Zhen (Aide in a Service of the Court of Imperial Entertainments) and Gu Xiang, and his younger brother is Gu Lu; he is married to a woman née Li. He placed sixty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Ke 徐恪 (registered in a civilian household in Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Gongsu; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six; born on the tenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Bogao; his grandfather was Xu Mengming; his father was Xu Minshu; his legal mother was née Zhou; and his birth mother is née Zhang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Xu Shen, Xu Kai, Xu Ti, Xu Huai, Xu Chi (District Magistrate), Xu Yi, and Xu Quan; he is married to a woman née Xu. He placed twelfth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and three hundred and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Yuanxue 周原學 (registered in a military household in Guangji County, Qizhou Department, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xigu; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine; born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Shuda; his grandfather was Zhou Jixian; his father was Zhou Sijing (Assistant Instructor); and his mother was née Li. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Zhou Yuanqi, Zhou Yuanguang, Zhou Yuanshan, Zhou Yuancong, and Zhou Yuantong; he is married to a woman née Tian. He placed second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Qian 蕭謙 (ancestral home Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; registered in a military household in Yongping Guard, Metropolitan Area; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Youzhong; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the first day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Zhong; his grandfather was Xiao Cheng; his father is Xiao Feng; and his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiao Yu, Xiao Lin, Xiao Tai, and Xiao Yi, and his younger brother is Xiao Guan; he is married to a woman née Li. He placed one hundred and sixteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.
