熊繡〔貫湖廣寧遠衛，軍籍，道州學生，治《禮記》，字汝明，行二，年二十六，五月二十八日生〕。曾祖景賢；祖世銘；父瑄；母龍氏。慈侍下。兄經，弟繪。娶周氏。湖廣鄉試第二十一名，會試第三百八名。

胡智〔貫河南汝寧府光州光山縣，民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字尚明，行四，年二十八，正月初五日生〕。曾祖才；祖名；父熈〔義官〕；母程氏。具慶下。兄仁、義、禮。娶鄒氏。河南鄉試第三十名，會試第九十一名。

吳俊〔貫浙江杭州府錢塘縣，民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字時用，行一，年二十八，七月二十二日生〕。曾祖友諒；祖淵宗；父福〔武昌知府〕；母孫氏，繼母樊氏。慈侍下。弟傑。娶侯氏。浙江鄉試第四十八名，會試第一百十二名。
translation_en:
Cui Jin 崔縉 [registered in a military household in Wenxi County 聞喜縣, Xiezhou 解州, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jinshen 縉紳; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Cui Min 敏; his grandfather was Cui Shou 壽; his father was Cui Zhen 振; and his mother is née Zhang 張. His mother is living (cishi xia). He is married to a woman née Jing 景. He placed ninth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Xiu 熊繡 [registered in a military household in Ningyuan Guard 寧遠衛, Huguang 湖廣; a Student of the Daozhou 道州 Subprefectural School specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Ruming 汝明; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiong Jingxian 景賢; his grandfather was Xiong Shiming 世銘; his father was Xiong Xuan 瑄; and his mother is née Long 龍. His mother is living. His elder brother is Xiong Jing 經, and his younger brother is Xiong Hui 繪. He is married to a woman née Zhou 周. He placed twenty-first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and three hundred eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Zhi 胡智 [registered in a civilian household in Guangshan County 光山縣, Guangzhou 光州, Runing Prefecture 汝寧府, Henan 河南; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shangming 尚明; fourth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the fifth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Cai 才; his grandfather was Hu Ming 名; his father is Hu Xi 熈 [Honorary Official (yiguan)]; and his mother is née Cheng 程. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Hu Ren 仁, Hu Yi 義, and Hu Li 禮. He is married to a woman née Zou 鄒. He placed thirtieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Jun 吳俊 [registered in a civilian household in Qiantang County 錢塘縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shiyong 時用; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Youliang 友諒; his grandfather was Wu Yuanzong 淵宗; his father was Wu Fu 福 [Prefect (zhifu) of Wuchang 武昌]; his mother was née Sun 孫, and his stepmother is née Fan 樊. His stepmother is living. His younger brother is Wu Jie 傑. He is married to a woman née Hou 侯. He placed forty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

成實〔貫湖廣漢川縣人，河南光州軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字廷秀，行三，年二十九，四月三十日生〕。曾祖原亮；祖宗政〔州判〕；父璟；母張氏。重慶下。兄宸、寶，弟憲、宣、宏、賓。娶唐氏。河南鄉試第六名，會試第三十五名。

芮畿〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字維瞻，行三，年三十一，八月二十七日生〕。曾祖叔遠；祖公明；父以端；母張氏。具慶下。弟田、畹、稷。娶儲氏，繼聘杜氏。應天府鄉試第七名，會試第三十名。

袁禎〔貫江西豐城縣人，山東兗州府曹州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字貞吉，行二，年三十八，十月二十日生〕。曾祖汝能〔贈監察御史〕；祖秉彜；父勗起；母徐氏。嚴侍下。弟裕、祥、祉、禧、祝。娶熊氏。順天府鄉試第四十一名，會試第三百十二名。
translation_en:
Cheng Shi 成實 (a native of Hanchuan County, Huguang, registered under a military household in Guang Subprefecture, Henan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingxiu, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the thirtieth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Cheng Yuanliang; his grandfather was Cheng Zongzheng (Assistant Subprefectural Magistrate); his father is Cheng Jing; and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Cheng Chen and Cheng Bao; his younger brothers are Cheng Xian, Cheng Xuan, Cheng Hong, and Cheng Bin. He married Lady Tang. He placed sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Shen 李紳 (a native of Pei County, Xu Subprefecture, Zhili, registered under a military artisan household in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; a Military Student in the Shuntian Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jinqing, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-three, born on the fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Li Chengju; his grandfather was Li Yi; his father was Li Zhao; and his mother is Lady Zhou. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brother is Li Xuanzhen. He is betrothed to Lady Liu. He placed twenty-third in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rui Ji 芮畿 (registered under a civilian household in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Weizhan, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Rui Shuyuan; his grandfather was Rui Gongming; his father is Rui Yiduan; and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Rui Tian, Rui Wan, and Rui Ji. He married Lady Chu and is subsequently betrothed to Lady Du. He placed seventh in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yuan Zhen 袁禎 (a native of Fengcheng County, Jiangxi, registered under a civilian household in Cao Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Zhenji, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yuan Runeng (posthumously honored as Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Yuan Bingyi; his father is Yuan Xuqi; and his mother was Lady Xu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Yuan Yu, Yuan Xiang, Yuan Zhi, Yuan Xi, and Yuan Zhu. He married Lady Xiong. He placed forty-first in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and three hundred and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Lin Zheng 林正 (registered under artisan household status in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; anAdded Student in the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Kequan; seniority number twenty-[?]; aged thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Yanfu, his grandfather was Weixiu, his father is Shangxinjie [?], his mother was Lady Chen, and his stepmother is Lady Wu. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Yuan, and he is married to Lady Xie. He placed thirty-eighth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Xiang 楊祥 (registered under hereditary military officer household status in Yongping Guard, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Mengzhen; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Pengfei (Subprefectural Magistrate under the Yuan), his grandfather was Cheng, his father is Xing (Guard Judge), his legal mother is Lady Gao, and his birth mother is Lady Xu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Fu (Investigating Censor), Qing (Guard Judge), and Yi. He is married to Lady Du. He placed ninetieth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and three hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Long Bo 龍伯 (registered under Confucian scholar household status in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Tingkui; first in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the seventeenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Ren'an (posthumously honoured as Secretary of a Bureau), his grandfather is Can (Secretary of a Bureau, posthumously honoured as Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Personnel), his father is Guang (Instructor), and his mother is Lady Hu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Tingwang and Tingguan, and he is married to Lady Yang. He placed seventy-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Run 吳潤 (registered under military household status in Deping County, Dezhou Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Gongze; third in seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zishi (posthumously honoured as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice), his grandfather was Da (Prefect of Quzhou Prefecture), his father was Qi, and his mother is Lady Liu. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Han and Pu (Tribute Student), and his younger brothers are Hao, Jiang, Yuan, and Huai. He is married to Lady Yang. He placed twelfth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xue Gong 薛恭 (registered in a civilian household of Jizhou 薊州 in Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shirong 士容; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the fourth day of the first lunar month). His great-grandfather was Xue Xian 先; his grandfather was Xue Youliang 友諒; his father was Xue Gui 貴; his mother was née Wang 王; and his stepmother was née Liu 劉. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Xue Jing 敬 and Xue Qian 謙. He married née Tian 田. He ranked 82nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 66th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Jin 郭進 (registered in a civilian household of Xianning County 咸寧縣 in Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yongzhi 用之; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the seventh day of the tenth lunar month). His great-grandfather was Guo Shouzheng 守政 (Assistant Pacification Commissioner under the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Guo Youxin 友信 (Company Commander); his father is Guo Shijie 士傑; and his mother is née Zhang 張. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Guo Zhen 振. He married née Yang 楊. He ranked 3rd in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 31st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhuang Chang 莊昶 (registered in a military household of Jiangpu County 江浦縣 in Yingtian Prefecture 應天府; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Kongyang 孔暘; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh lunar month). His great-grandfather was Zhuang Wu 武; his grandfather was Zhuang Zhifu 志甫; his father is Zhuang Xu 詡; and his mother is née Ren 任. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhuang Wen 文, Zhuang Hao 顥, and Zhuang Ang 昂; his younger brothers are Zhuang Min 旻, Zhuang Hao 昊, Zhuang Yu 昱, Zhuang Sheng 晟, Zhuang Yan 晏, Zhuang Sheng 昇, Zhuang Jing 景, and Zhuang Bian 昪. He married née Li 李. He ranked 86th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 23rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Yong 韓鏞 (registered in a saltern household of Fuqing County 福清縣 in Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenliang 文亮; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth lunar month). His great-grandfather was Han Zhonggang 仲鋼; his grandfather was Han Shicheng 士誠; his father is Han Tingwei 廷瑋; and his mother is née Zheng 鄭. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Han Yu 鈺 and Han Jun 鈞. He married née Zheng 鄭. He ranked 11th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 194th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Ren Ying 任英 [registered in a civilian household of Qiantang County 錢塘縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a District Student (xian xuesheng), specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Guangbi 光弼; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ren Zhongxiang 仲祥, his grandfather was Ren De 德, his father was Ren Zhong 忠, and his mother was Lady Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brothers are Ren Xian 賢, Ren Yi 義, and Ren Yu 瑀. He married Lady Yun 雲氏. He ranked sixty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Lian 陳璉 [registered in a civilian household of Jinxian County 進賢縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; a National University Student (guozi sheng), specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Banggui 邦貴; twelfth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the tenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Youren 友仁, his grandfather was Chen Shijing 仕敬, his father was Chen Zining 子寧, and his mother is Lady Xiang 向氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Chen Bin 斌, Chen Rui 瑞, Chen Huan 瓛 [Assistant Instructor (xundao)], Chen Shan 珊, and Chen Ying 瑛; his younger brothers are Chen Qi 琦, Chen Huan 環, and Chen Can 璨. He ranked sixteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Gao 趙杲 [registered in a military household of Cang Department 滄州, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Zhili 直隸; a National University Student (guozi sheng), specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Dehui 德輝; second in seniority among his brothers; aged forty, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Shi'an 世安, his grandfather was Zhao Shicheng 士成, his father is Zhao Xin 信, and his mother is Lady Yan 閻氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Zhao Jing 景, and his younger brothers are Zhao Quan 全 and Zhao Xuan 宣. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He ranked one hundredth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gui Tinggui 桂廷圭 [registered in a military household of Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; an Administrative Intern (banshi guan), specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Gongrui 公瑞; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-three, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Gui Yanliang 彥良 [Right Tutor (you fu) of the Princely Establishment of Jin 晉府], his grandfather was Gui Shen 慎 [Drafter (zhongshu sheren)], his father is Gui Baosun 抱孫, his legal mother was Lady Zhu 朱氏, and his birth mother was Lady Shao 邵氏. His father is living and his mothers are deceased (yanshi xia). His elder brothers are Gui Tingyan 廷琰 and Gui Tinglu 廷禄 [Assistant Instructor (xundao)], and his younger brothers are Gui Tingfan 廷璠, Gui Tingyu 廷璵, Gui Tingzhang 廷璋, Gui Tingxiu 廷琇, and Gui Tingzhen 廷珎. He married Lady Shao 邵氏, and subsequently married Lady Ji 紀氏. He ranked one hundred thirty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

東思忠〔貫陝西西安府華州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字進伯，行二，年二十六，十月十五日生〕。曾祖良惠〔元知州〕，祖驥，父昇〔縣丞〕，前母郭氏，母郭氏。具慶下。兄奉先，弟思誠、思恭。娶薛氏。陝西鄉試第二十二名，會試第二百四十名。

屠滽〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字朝宗，行二，年二十七，九月二十五日生〕。曾祖順，祖子真，父瑜，母徐氏。重慶下。兄湘，弟渭。娶薛氏。浙江鄉試第六十名，會試第二百二十二名。
translation_en:
Wan Shan 萬山 (registered in a civilian household of Macheng County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shoufu; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wan Renyuan, his grandfather was Wan Biming, his father was Wan Yong, and his mother is née Duan. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Wan Qian and Wan Yu (an official awaiting appointment), and his younger brother is Wan Gang. He married née Zeng. He ranked 60th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 92nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Xiao 李斅 (registered in a civilian household of Fuliang County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Kecheng; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-third day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Li Junxian, his grandfather was Li Wende, his father is Li Bangxing, and his mother is née Fang. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Chang, Li Min, Li Hui, Li Fu, and Li Jiao. He married née Wu. He ranked 9th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 71st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Sizhong 東思忠 (registered in a civilian household of Hua Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jinbo; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Dong Lianghui (Subprefectural Magistrate in the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Dong Ji, his father is Dong Sheng (Vice Magistrate), his father's former wife was née Guo, and his mother is née Guo. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Dong Fengxian, and his younger brothers are Dong Sicheng and Dong Sigong. He married née Xue. He ranked 22nd in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 240th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Yong 屠滽 (registered in a civilian household of Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a prefectural school student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chaozong; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Tu Shun, his grandfather is Tu Zizhen, his father is Tu Yu, and his mother is née Xu. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Tu Xiang, and his younger brother is Tu Wei. He married née Xue. He ranked 60th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 222nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

譚公望〔貫湖廣長沙府茶陵縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字周佐，行二，年三十二，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖善慶；祖隆〔戶部主事〕；父瓚；母彭氏。慈侍下。弟公弼、公衡、公景。娶劉氏。湖廣鄉試第六十六名，會試第一百七十五名。

管昌〔貫直隸崑山縣人，錦衣衛軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字世隆，行五，年三十，七月初二日生〕。曾祖子銘；祖仲彬；父璩；母沈氏。慈侍下。兄昪〔訓導〕、昻、昱、昇。娶朱氏。順天府鄉試第二名，會試第三十九名。
translation_en:
Wu Wenyuan 吳文元 [registered in a civilian household of Ouning County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian; County School Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shanzhang; first in generational order; age thirty-six, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Zi'an; his grandfather was Wu Zhongming; his father is Wu Zhi [Instructor in the Directorate of Education]; his mother was Lady Zhang; and his stepmother is Lady Huang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Wu Wenheng and Wu Wenzhen. He married Lady Lian. He placed 89th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 61st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Tao 董韜 [registered in a civilian household of Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tingxian; second in generational order; age forty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Songpo [posthumously granted the title of Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Rites]; his grandfather was Dong Yingwei [Director of the Prefectural Yin-Yang School]; his father was Dong Shangcai; his mother was Lady Ruan; and his stepmother was Lady Ying. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Dong Chen; his younger brothers are Dong Jing, Dong Qin, Dong Jian, and Dong Xuan. He married Lady Qian. He placed 15th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 14th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Gongwang 譚公望 [registered in a military household of Chaling County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhouzuo; second in generational order; age thirty-two, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Tan Shanqing; his grandfather was Tan Long [Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father was Tan Zan; and his mother is Lady Peng. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Tan Gongbi, Tan Gongheng, and Tan Gongjing. He married Lady Liu. He placed 66th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 175th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guan Chang 管昌 [native of Kunshan County, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered in a military household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shilong; fifth in generational order; age thirty, born on the second day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Guan Ziming; his grandfather was Guan Zhongbin; his father was Guan Qu; and his mother is Lady Shen. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Guan Bian [Assistant Instructor], Guan Ang, Guan Yu, and Guan Sheng. He married Lady Zhu. He placed 2nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 39th in the Metropolitan Examination.

江弘濟〔貫浙江開化縣人，直隸安慶府桐城縣官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字本深，行二二，年四十二，八月初四日生〕。曾祖濬〔元朝議〕；祖珊；父廉〔教授〕；母許氏。永感下。兄諤、調、儀、鳳、鸞、襲、謹、詠、謙、訥、誠、弘載。娶金氏。應天府鄉試第一百七十名，會試第二百六十四名。

translation_en:
Zhang Wei 張瑋 (registered under a military household in Jingzhou 景州, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Zhili 直隸; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Ruqi 汝器; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight; born on the fourth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Jingzu 敬祖; his grandfather was Zhang Jingchu 景初; his father was Zhang Xian 顯 (Confucian School Instructor); and his mother is née Song 宋氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Zhang Heng 珩, Zhang Xuan 璿, Zhang Ji 璣, and Zhang Ju 琚. He married née Xin 辛氏, and remarried née Hou 侯氏. He placed sixty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tai 張泰 (registered under a civilian household in Shunde County 順德縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shuheng 叔亨; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one; born on the seventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Keda 可達; his grandfather was Zhang Zizhen 子真 (invested with honorific title as Guard Registrar); his father is Zhang Ying 英 (Guard Registrar); and his mother is née Ou 區氏 (invested with the title of Child Nurturess [ruren]). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Zhen 禎 and Zhang Shun 順; his younger brother is Zhang Qing 慶. He married née He 何氏. He placed seventy-sixth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Hongji 江弘濟 (originally from Kaihua County 開化縣, Zhejiang 浙江, registered under an official household in Tongcheng County 桐城縣, Anqing Prefecture 安慶府, Zhili 直隸; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Benshen 本深; twenty-second in seniority in his generation; aged forty-two; born on the fourth day of the eighth month). Lu Run 陸潤 (registered under a civilian household in Changshu County 常熟縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Zhili 直隸; Confucian scholar [rushi] specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Changze 昌澤; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one; born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Kejing 克敬, his grandfather Sizheng 思政 [County Recorder], his father Duo 鐸, and his mother née Ma 馬氏. Both parents are living. His great-grandfather was Rong 榮, his grandfather Ying 瑛 [Vice Magistrate], his father Shi 軾 [Department Magistrate], and his mother née Chen 陳氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Lan 蘭 and E 蕚. He married née Yang 楊氏. He placed third in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Lian 黃璉 [registered in a civilian household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruqi 汝器; second in generational order; age thirty, born on the fifth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zongdao 宗道, his grandfather Hongzhong 宏中, his father Benqing 本清, and his mother née Yu 俞氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Huan 𤧸, and his younger brothers are Huan 環, Heng 珩, Xuan 璿, Ji 璣, and Qi 琦. He married née Xu 許氏. He placed fiftieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Duan Zheng 段正 (native of Zezhou 澤州, Shanxi 山西, registered in a military household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard 錦衣衛; Prefectural Student of Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yizhong 以中; first in order of seniority; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Duan Yun 贇, his grandfather was Duan Fengxian 奉先, his father was Duan Shan 善, and his mother was née Chang 常氏. Both parents are living; he married née Zhou 周氏. He placed fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and two hundred and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shang Jing 尚敬 (registered in a civilian household of Linying County 臨潁縣, Xuzhou 許州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongli 宗禮; third in order of seniority; age thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Shang Qing 清, his grandfather was Shang Zhi 志, his father was Shang Jun 俊 (Prefectural Registrar), his mother was née Yang 楊氏, and his stepmother was née Zhang 張氏. His father and stepmother are both living; his elder brothers are Shang Zhi 質 and Shang Wen 文, his younger brothers are Shang Cheng 誠 (Prefectural Medical Instructor) and Shang Xian 賢, and he married née Li 李氏. He placed eleventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Tong 余統 (registered in a civilian household of Xinhui County 新會縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Chengzhi 承之; second in order of seniority; age thirty-six, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Huazheng 華政, his grandfather was Yu Miaocheng 妙成, his father was Yu Tianrui 添瑞, and his mother was née Li 李氏. Both parents are living; his elder brother is Yu Yuanliang 元諒 (metropolitan graduate, jinshi), his younger brothers are Yu Yi 肄, Yu Gong 貢, and Yu Hui 會, and he married née Huang 黃氏. He placed eighty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred and eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qiu Shan 丘山 (registered in a military household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Anzhong 安重; third in order of seniority; age thirty-six, born on the seventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Qiu Shizhang 士章, his grandfather was Qiu Kongzhen 孔珎, his father was Qiu Wenji 文璣, his mother was née Lin 林氏, and his stepmothers were née Fang 方氏 and née Zhu 朱氏. His stepmother is living; his elder brothers are Qiu Mo 謨 and Qiu Hong 鋐, his younger brothers are Qiu Liang 諒 (tribute scholar, gongshi), Qiu Qiang 鏘, Qiu Qian 謙, and Qiu Jian 諫, and he married née Lin 林氏. He placed sixty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Tang Shilong, his grandfather was Tang Sijing, his father is Tang Zhongjie, and his mother is née Bao. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Tang Hong, Tang Xuan, Tang Yi, Tang Yu, Tang Yin, Tang Rong, Tang Cai, and Tang Bao. He is married to a woman née Chen. He placed 80th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Sheng 譚昇 [originally from You County, Huguang, registered in an official military household of the Lancang Guard in Yunnan; Prefectural Student of Beisheng Subprefecture; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Gongzhao; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Tan Jueshan, his grandfather was Tan Wucheng, his father is Tan Xin [retired Platoon Commander (baihu)], and his mother is née Lin. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Tan Hui [Platoon Commander] and Tan Xi. He married a woman née Huang, and remarried a woman née Liu. He placed 10th in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 193rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Di 湯滌 [registered in a military household in Jiaxing County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Xinzhi; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Tang Rongfu, his grandfather was Tang Jing, his father is Tang Hao, and his mother is née Han. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Tang Shu. He is married to a woman née Wang. He placed 90th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 59th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Bin 王賓 [registered in a civilian household in Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Yongzhi; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month]. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Rui, Wang Qi, Wang Li, Wang Lin, Wang Yu, Wang Cheng, and Wang Fu. He is married to a woman née Zhang. He placed 5th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 148th in the Metropolitan Examination.

王浩〔貫應天府上元縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字德宏，行一，年三十九，十二月初六日生〕。曾祖祥三；祖仲彬；父忠，母許氏，繼母沈氏。具慶下，弟瀚、淮、渭，娶李氏。應天府鄉試第一百二十名，會試第一百八十三名。

王繼〔貫河南開封府祥符縣匠籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字述之，行二，年三十四，三月初一日生〕。曾祖均玉；祖覺玉；父廷器，母范氏。慈侍下，兄綜，弟恭、寬、敏，娶滕氏。河南鄉試第六十名，會試第一百九名。
translation_en:
Huang Ben 黃本 [registered in a civilian household in Le'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; Confucian Scholar (rushi); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Qiaoyue 喬嶽; second in generational order; age twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zezhong 擇中; his grandfather was Zhenming 貞明; his father is Zhidao 直道, his mother was née He 何, and his stepmother is née Zou 鄒. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Qiaosong 喬嵩, Qiaogang 喬崗, and Qiaoluan 喬巒; he married née Hao 郝. He placed 58th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 227th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Ji 李紀 [registered in a civilian household in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached region (Zhili); County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Yongxiu 用脩; fourth in generational order; age twenty-three, born on the sixth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Tingzhen 廷震; his grandfather was Maoqing 茂卿; his father is Zhi 智 and his mother is née Gui 桂. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Shun 順, Hong 紅 [?], and Jie 結 [?], and his younger brother is Jin 縉; he married née Cui 崔. He placed 69th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 289th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Hao 王浩 [registered in a military household in Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Dehong 德宏; first in generational order; age thirty-nine, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiangsan 祥三; his grandfather was Zhongbin 仲彬; his father is Zhong 忠, his mother was née Xu 許, and his stepmother is née Shen 沈. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Han 瀚, Huai 淮, and Wei 渭; he married née Li 李. He placed 120th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 183rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ji 王繼 [registered in an artisan household in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Shuzhi 述之; second in generational order; age thirty-four, born on the first day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Junyu 均玉; his grandfather was Jueyu 覺玉; his father was Tingqi 廷器 and his mother is née Fan 范. His mother is living; his elder brother is Zong 綜, and his younger brothers are Gong 恭, Kuan 寬, and Min 敏; he married née Teng 滕. He placed 60th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 109th in the Metropolitan Examination.

謝寧〔貫福建泉州府惠安縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字安世，行三，年三十七，四月初四日生〕。曾祖仁貴，祖文秀，父孟斌，母黃氏。具慶下。兄崇德、崇善，弟崇周、崇清，娶連氏。福建鄉試第五十七名，會試第一百四十三名。

曹鼐〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字國用，行二，年三十二，二月初七日生〕。曾祖漢英，祖璘，父琦，母趙氏。具慶下。兄鼎，弟鼒、鼏，娶夏氏。應天府鄉試第六十三名，會試第二百七名。

蘇盛〔貫直隸大名府元城縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字文盛，行三，年三十，十月二十五日生〕。曾祖名旺〔知縣〕，祖弘，父宗〔錦衣衛鎮撫〕，母楊氏。慈侍下。兄榮〔鎮撫〕、興，娶齊氏。順天府鄉試第二十四名，會試第一百三十七名。
translation_en:
Wang Jun 王濬 [registered under a civilian household in Wei County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; Directorate Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Keshen; seventh in generational order; age thirty-six; born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Bocheng, his grandfather was Zhigang, his father was Rong, his legal mother was Lady Li, and his birth mother was Lady Wang. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Kuan, You, Cai, Ze, Tong, Gong, and Zhen; he married Lady Jiang. He placed eighty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Ning 謝寧 [registered under a military household in Hui'an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Directorate Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Anshi; third in generational order; age thirty-seven; born on the fourth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Rengui, his grandfather was Wenxiu, his father is Mengbin, and his mother is Lady Huang. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Chongde and Chongshan, and his younger brothers are Chongzhou and Chongqing; he married Lady Lian. He placed fifty-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Nai 曹鼐 [registered under a civilian household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Zhili; Prefectural Student (fuxue sheng); specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Guoyong; second in generational order; age thirty-two; born on the seventh day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Hanying, his grandfather was Lin, his father is Qi, and his mother is Lady Zhao. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Ding, and his younger brothers are Zi and Mi; he married Lady Xia. He placed sixty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Su Sheng 蘇盛 [registered under a military household in Yuancheng County, Daming Prefecture, Zhili; Directorate Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wensheng; third in generational order; age thirty; born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Mingwang [District Magistrate (zhixian)], his grandfather was Hong, his father was Zong [Judge of the Embroidered-uniform Guard (Jinyiwei zhenfu)], and his mother is Lady Yang. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Rong [Judge (zhenfu)] and Xing; he married Lady Qi. He placed twenty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Xiang 王相 [native of Xinchang County, Ruizhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, of civilian household registration, a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Leyong, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Shijie; his grandfather was Wang Yongdi; his father is Wang Weixin; his mother was née Zhou, and his stepmother is née Cao. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Legeng and Wang Lezhi. He married née Chen, and later married née Cheng. He ranked 62nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 168th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Hong 程宏 [native of Qimen County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili, of civilian household registration, an Added Student in the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Yifu, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twentieth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was named Cheng Zhe; his grandfather was Cheng Fu; his father is Cheng Han; his mother was née Fang, and his stepmother is née Jin. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Cheng Shi and Cheng Yi. He married née Xie. He ranked 2nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 72nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Hui 陳惠 [native of Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of civilian household registration, a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Qishun, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged forty-two, born on the twenty-eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Jing; his grandfather was Chen Xi; his father was Chen Zhouyuan; his mother was née Xiao [?]. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Chen De, Chen Gong, and Chen He; his younger brothers are Chen Ying and Chen Xin. He married née Xie. He ranked 105th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Jun 楊峻 [native of Jinxian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, of civilian household registration, a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), courtesy name Weigao, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the twentieth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Rongshou; his grandfather was Yang Zhongwen; his father is Yang Jingshan; his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Chong, Yang Yue, and Yang Zheng; his younger brothers are Yang Huan, Yang Yu, Yang Luan, and Yang Song. He married née Rao. He ranked 30th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 166th in the Metropolitan Examination.

胡琮〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣匠籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字文德，行二，年二十八，閏二月二十日生〕。曾祖仲達，祖彥敬，父晟，母徐氏。慈侍下，兄瑨，娶闞氏。應天府鄉試第七十一名，會試第二百四十一名。

楊守隨〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣官籍，府學生，治《易經》，字惟貞，行五，年三十二，八月十八日生〕。曾祖浩卿，祖九疇，父自愈，母張氏。具慶下，兄守陳〔編修〕、守防，弟守阯〔舉人〕、守隅、守隰、守陛、守隄、守隅，娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第三十八名，會試第六十八名。

劉璋〔貫河南都司衛輝千戶所官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷圭，行二，年二十七，三月十九日生〕。曾祖聰〔百戶〕，祖恕，父英〔百戶〕，母胡氏。慈侍下，兄璽，弟瓚，娶張氏。河南鄉試第五十三名，會試第八十名。

劉魁〔貫山東東昌府高唐州民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字士元，行一，年三十一，五月初四日生〕。曾祖章甫，祖景文，父以純，母竇氏。具慶下，娶張氏。山東鄉試第十六名，會試第二百六十六名。
translation_en:
Hu Cong 胡琮 [registered in an artisan household in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; County Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wende; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the intercalary second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongda, his grandfather was Yanjing, his father was Sheng, and his mother is née Xu. His mother is living; his elder brother is Jin, and he is married to née Kan. He placed 71st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 241st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Shousui 楊守隨 [registered in an official household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; Prefectural Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weizhen; fifth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Haoqing, his grandfather was Jiuchou, his father is Ziyu, and his mother is née Zhang. Both his parents are living; his elder brothers are Shouchen (Historiographer) and Shoufang, his younger brothers are Shouzhi (provincial graduate), Shouyu, Shouxin, Shoubi, Shoudi, and Shouyu [?], and he is married to née Chen. He placed 38th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 68th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhang 劉璋 [registered in an official household of the Weihui Battalion under the Henan Regional Military Commission; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Tinggui; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Cong (Company Commander), his grandfather was Shu, his father was Ying (Company Commander), and his mother is née Hu. His mother is living; his elder brother is Xi, his younger brother is Zan, and he is married to née Zhang. He placed 53rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 80th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Kui 劉魁 [registered in a civilian household in Gaotang Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shiyuan; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the fourth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhangfu, his grandfather was Jingwen, his father is Yichun, and his mother is née Dou. Both his parents are living; he is married to née Zhang. He placed 16th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 266th in the Metropolitan Examination.

馮寧〔貫陝西西安府耀州同官縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字靖之，行三，年三十四，二月二十七日生〕。曾祖淵，祖敏，父貴〔副提舉〕，母王氏。具慶下。兄賓、安，弟宣、宏、寬、宥。娶畢氏。陝西鄉試第二十二名，會試第二百十七名。

translation_en:
Zhong Sheng 鍾晟 (registered in a military household in Panyu County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Meixuan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhong Yuanliang, his grandfather was Zhong Yanchen, his father was Zhong Ding, and his mother was née Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Zhong Min, and he is married to née Huang. He ranked first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 209th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Sheng 方昇 (registered in an official household in the Yuezhou Guard, Huguang; a student of the Yuezhou Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Qidong; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-ninth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Fang Yu (Judge), his grandfather was Fang Lin (Judge), his father was Fang Shu, and his mother was née Li. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Fang Ding, Fang Qian, and Fang Heng; his younger brothers are Fang Guan and Fang Kun; and he is married to née Dai. He ranked first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 245th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Ning 馮寧 (registered in a civilian household in Tongguan County, Yaozhou Department, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jingzhi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-seventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Feng Yuan, his grandfather was Feng Min, his father was Feng Gui (Vice Intendant), and his mother was née Wang. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Feng Bin and Feng An; his younger brothers are Feng Xuan, Feng Hong, Feng Kuan, and Feng You; and he is married to née Bi. He ranked 22nd in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 217th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhong Fan 鍾蕃 (originally from Chongde County, Zhejiang, registered in a military household in the Front Leftover Guard; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingfang; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Zhong Bingren, his grandfather was Zhong Sheng, his father was Zhong Sheng, his mother was née Zhu, and his stepmother is née Li. Both his parents and grandparents are living, and he is married to née Cai. He ranked 20th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 10th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
徐英〔貫直隸廣平府永年縣，民籍，國子生。治《禮記》，字文華，行一，年三十三，七月二十八日生〕。曾祖謙〔晋府伴讀〕，祖瑄〔贈户部郎中〕，父敬〔福建右叅政〕，母段氏〔封宜人〕。慈侍下，弟芳、蕙，娶魏氏。順天府鄉試第十名，會試第二百名。

黎福〔貫江西饒州府樂平縣，民籍，國子生。治《易經》，字天與，行六，年三十二，七月十八日生〕。曾祖偉德，祖仕雅，父憲常，母胡氏。具慶下，兄祜、輔，弟貴、昉、旭，娶王氏。江西鄉試第八名，會試第一百八十五名。

鄒儒〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣，民籍，府學生。治《詩經》，字宗魯，行三，年四十，七月初三日生〕。曾祖仕宏，祖至剛，父世隆，母萬氏。慈侍下，兄近魯、希魯，弟繼魯、承魯、學魯、本魯、紹魯，娶羅氏。江西鄉試第六十六名，會試第六十三名。

張進禄〔貫陝西延安府綏德州清澗縣，軍籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字天錫，行二，年三十七，正月二十八日生〕。曾祖仲賢，祖時敏〔知縣〕，父文斌〔巡檢〕，嫡母薛氏，生母楊氏。慈侍下，兄福□，弟祺、禮、禎、祥、祐、祜、裕，娶姚氏。陝西鄉試第五十八名，會試第三百四十四名。
translation_en:
Xu Ying 徐英: Registered as a civilian household in Yongnian County 永年縣, Guangping Prefecture 廣平府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozijian). He specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji), his courtesy name is Wenhua 文華, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Xu Qian 謙 (Reader-companion in the Princely Establishment of Jin 晉府), his grandfather was Xu Xuan 瑄 (posthumously honoured as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue), his father was Xu Jing 敬 (Right Administration Vice Commissioner of Fujian 福建), and his mother is Madam Duan 段氏 (invested as Lady of Suitability). His mother is living (cishi xia); his younger brothers are Fang 芳 and Hui 蕙; and he is married to Madam Wei 魏氏. He placed 10th in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 200th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Fu 黎福: Registered as a civilian household in Leping County 樂平縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi 江西; a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Tianyu 天與, he is sixth in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-two years old, born on the eighteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Li Weide 偉德, his grandfather was Li Shiya 仕雅, his father is Li Xianchang 憲常, and his mother is Madam Hu 胡氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia); his elder brothers are Hu 祜 and Fu 輔; his younger brothers are Gui 貴, Fang 昉, and Xu 旭; and he is married to Madam Wang 王氏. He placed 8th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 185th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zou Ru 鄒儒: Registered as a civilian household in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi; a prefectural school student. He specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Zonglu 宗魯, he is third in seniority among his brothers, and he is forty years old, born on the third day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Zou Shihong 仕宏, his grandfather was Zou Zhigang 至剛, his father was Zou Shilong 世隆, and his mother is Madam Wan 萬氏. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Jinlu 近魯 and Xilu 希魯; his younger brothers are Jilu 繼魯, Chenglu 承魯, Xuelu 學魯, Benlu 本魯, and Shaolu 紹魯; and he is married to Madam Luo 羅氏. He placed 66th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 63rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jinlu 張進禄: Registered as a military household in Qingjian County 清澗縣, Suide Subprefecture 綏德州, Yan'an Prefecture 延安府, Shaanxi 陝西; a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Tianxi 天錫, he is second in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-seven years old, born on the twenty-eighth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhongxian 仲賢, his grandfather was Zhang Shimin 時敏 (District Magistrate), his father was Zhang Wenbin 文斌 (Police Chief), his legal mother was Madam Xue 薛氏, and his birth mother is Madam Yang 楊氏. His mother is living; his elder brother is Fu[?] 福□; his younger brothers are Qi 祺, Li 禮, Zhen 禎, Xiang 祥, You 祐, Hu 祜, and Yu 裕; and he is married to Madam Yao 姚氏. He placed 58th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 344th in the Metropolitan Examination.

===

治禮記字必照行一年三十二八月十七日生
曾祖恭 祖友 父麟 母邵氏
具慶下 弟旭 杲 娶魏氏
應天府鄉試第三十六名 會試第八十二名

曾祖子文 祖伯器 父崇襄 母康氏
永感下 兄承歡 承濟 承俊 娶劉氏
江西鄉試第十四名 會試第一百五十四名
punctuated:
羅睿〔貫陝西蘭州衛人，蘭縣學軍生，治《書經》，字文哲，行一，年二十七，四月初五日生〕。曾祖榮；祖昇；父真，母聶氏。具慶下。娶蕭氏。陝西鄉試第二十名，會試第二百五十四名。

林廷庸〔貫福建閩縣人，廣東興寧縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷庸，行二，年三十四，正月初十日生〕。曾祖子美；祖澤；父汝大，母鄭氏。具慶下。兄惇〔訓導〕、焴、熺，弟燁。娶鄭氏。廣東鄉試第十六名，會試第三百四十三名。

王昶〔貫直隸鳳陽府宿州靈璧縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字必照，行一，年三十二，八月十七日生〕。曾祖恭；祖友；父麟，母邵氏。具慶下。弟旭、杲。娶魏氏。應天府鄉試第三十六名，會試第八十二名。

蕭蒼〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字承表，行四，年三十三，六月十三日生〕。曾祖子文；祖伯器；父崇襄，母康氏。永感下。兄承歡、承濟、承俊。娶劉氏。江西鄉試第十四名，會試第一百五十四名。
translation_en:
Luo Rui 羅睿 (courtesy name Wenzhe 文哲, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the fifth day of the fourth month) was from Lanzhou Guard 蘭州衛 in Shaanxi, served as a military student at the Lan County School 蘭縣學, and specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Luo Rong 榮, his grandfather was Luo Sheng 昇, his father was Luo Zhen 真, and his mother was Lady Nie 聶氏. Both of his parents were living, and he was married to Lady Xiao 蕭氏. He placed twentieth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Tingyong 林廷庸 (courtesy name Tingyong 廷庸, second in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the tenth day of the first month) was originally from Min County 閩縣 in Fujian and registered in a civilian household in Xingning County 興寧縣, Guangdong; he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Lin Zimei 子美, his grandfather was Lin Ze 澤, his father was Lin Ruda 汝大, and his mother was Lady Zheng 鄭氏. Both of his parents were living; his elder brothers were Lin Dun 惇 (an Assistant Instructor), Lin Yu 焴, and Lin Xi 熺, his younger brother was Lin Ye 燁, and he was married to Lady Zheng 鄭氏. He placed sixteenth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and three hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chang 王昶 (courtesy name Bizhao 必照, first in seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month) was registered in a civilian household in Lingbi County 靈璧縣, Suzhou 宿州, Fengyang Prefecture 鳳陽府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); he was a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His great-grandfather was Wang Gong 恭, his grandfather was Wang You 友, his father was Wang Lin 麟, and his mother was Lady Shao 邵氏. Both of his parents were living; his younger brothers were Wang Xu 旭 and Wang Gao 杲, and he was married to Lady Wei 魏氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Cang 蕭蒼 (courtesy name Chengbiao 承表, fourth in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month) was registered in a civilian household in Taihe County 泰和縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Xiao Ziwen 子文, his grandfather was Xiao Boqi 伯器, his father was Xiao Chongxiang 崇襄, and his mother was Lady Kang 康氏. Both of his parents were deceased; his elder brothers were Xiao Chenghuan 承歡, Xiao Chengji 承濟, and Xiao Chengjun 承俊, and he was married to Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed fourteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

王俊〔貫福建福州府閩縣匠籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字世英，行七，年二十四，五月初二日生〕。曾祖靜；祖定；父寧，前母魏氏，母申氏，繼母蕭氏。具慶下。兄坦、安，弟傑、浩。娶陳氏，繼娶趙氏。福建鄉試第十名，會試第五名。

translation_en:
Dai Zhong 戴中 [registered in a civilian household in Xingan County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; an expectant student (zengguangsheng) of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shizhong, tenth in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yuanliang; his grandfather was Mao'an; his father is Yunyuan, and his mother is née Mao. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Shizhang, and his younger brothers are Shike and Shiru. He is married to née Wang. He ranked 45th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 34th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Hui 徐輝 [originally from Jiaxing County, Zhejiang, registered in a military household of the Fuyu Guard; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kongzhao, first in his generation; age forty-two, born on the fourth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Yuanshi; his grandfather was Yansheng; his father is Lang, and his mother is née Peng. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Yao, Xuan, Huan, and Xi. He is married to née Wang. He ranked 42nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 246th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jun 王俊 [registered in an artisan household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shiying, seventh in his generation; age twenty-four, born on the second day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Jing; his grandfather was Ding; his father is Ning, his father's former wife was née Wei, his mother was née Shen, and his stepmother is née Xiao. His father and stepmother are both living. His elder brothers are Tan and An, and his younger brothers are Jie and Hao. He married née Chen, and later married née Zhao. He ranked 10th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 5th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Yong 戴用 [registered in a civilian household in Wan'an County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingxian, first in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the fourth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Wenbin; his grandfather was Changshan; his father is Renbang, and his mother is née Peng. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Jin. He is married to née Li. He ranked 90th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 216th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhai Tinghui 翟庭蕙 [registered in a physician household in Luoyang County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xiufu 秀夫; second in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-first day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhai Yishu 以恕, his grandfather was Zhai Zichun 子春, his father is Zhai Tong 通 [Prefectural Physician in the Medical School], and his mother is née Feng 封. Both parents are living; he has an elder brother Tinglan 庭蘭 and younger brothers Tingzhi 庭芝 and Tingpu 庭莆, and he married née Ge 葛. He placed twentieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Bo 徐博 [registered in an artisan household in Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dehong 德宏; third in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Junjie 俊傑, his grandfather was Xu Ziying 子英, his father is Xu Shu 述, his father's former wives were née Gu 顧 and née Luo 羅, and his mother is née Chen 陳. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Hui 恢, Bian 忭, De 惪, Chen 忱, and Qi 愭, and a younger brother Shi 栻, and he married née Zhang 張. He placed eighty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and three hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Ju 黃𡩠 [registered in a civilian household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Confucian Scholar; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shiyong 世用; second in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the twelfth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Linzi 麟子 [Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice], his grandfather was Huang Yu 與, his father is Huang Yong 雍 [Grand Coordinator (or Police Chief, xunji 巡檢 [?])], and his mother is née You 游. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Ning 寧 and Cai 寀 and a younger brother Chen 宸, and he married née Cai 蔡. He placed eighth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jing 劉璟 [registered in a civilian household in Wuling County, Changde Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiying 時瑩; first in his generation; aged thirty, born on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Rufu 汝富, his grandfather was Liu Zhongren 仲仁, his father is Liu Guang 廣 [District Jailor], and his mother is née Xiang 項. Both parents are living; he has a younger brother Yuan 瑗, and he married née Wang 王. He placed second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Shijin 張時謹 (registered in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, under Confucian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Weihou; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Zongzhen; his grandfather was Zhang Yuesheng; his father is Zhang Qiu (Prefectural Instructor); and his mother was née Tang. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhang Shizhong and Zhang Shiqi (Assistant Instructor); his younger brother is Zhang Shida (Secretary in the Ministry of Works). He married née Qiu. He placed 166th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 307th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Zan 呂讚 (registered in Taihu County, Anqing Prefecture, Zhili, under military household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyang; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twelfth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Lü Yishi; his grandfather was Lü Heng (Investigating Censor); his father is Lü Liang; and his mother was née Zheng. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Lü Qian, Lü Liang, and Lü Yong; his younger brothers are Lü Mi, Lü Song, and Lü Zhong. He married née Zhang. He placed 85th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 244th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Lun 馬綸 (registered in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, under civilian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Dalun; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Ma Wenzhi; his grandfather was Ma Fu (District Magistrate); his father is Ma Weishan (Registrar); his mother was née Lu, and his stepmothers are née Xu and née Yuan. Both his parents are living (father and stepmother). His elder brothers are Ma Kun, Ma Cheng (metropolitan graduate, jinshi), and Ma Jing; his younger brothers are Ma Xu, Ma Qin (metropolitan graduate of the same examination class), Ma Ji, Ma Yun, and Ma Jiu. He married née Yin. He placed 105th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 113th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Hai 沈海 (registered in Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, under civilian household status; a Confucian scholar specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Guanlan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the intercalary twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Yuqing; his grandfather was Shen Fu; his father was Shen Da; and his mother is née Zhu. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He married née Zhu. He placed 59th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 17th in the Metropolitan Examination.

許進〔貫河南河南府陝州靈寶縣民籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字季升，行三，年三十，五月初三日生〕。曾祖仕信；祖實；父聚〔教諭〕；母何氏。重慶下。兄通、迪。娶張氏。河南鄉試第十五名，會試第一百七十八名。

余金〔貫四川成都府內江縣醫籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字貢之，行一，年三十七，十二月十六日生〕。曾祖朝卿；祖道昇；父綱；母吳氏。具慶下。弟玉〔貢士〕、山、泉、琳、玠、瑄。娶洪氏。四川鄉試第五十六名，會試第二百五十二名。
translation_en:
Chen Ce 陳策: Registered under an official household in Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a prefectural student (fuxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jiamo 嘉謨; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the eighth day of the intercalary tenth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Junde 陳均得; his grandfather was Chen Yicheng 陳以誠; his father was Chen Xuan 陳宣 (Assistant Instructor [xundao]); and his mother was Lady Fei 費氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He is married to Lady Wu 吳氏. He placed 8th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 89th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Tan 陳潭: Registered under a civilian household in Changle County 長樂縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; an added-quota county student (xianxue zengguangsheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Mengming 孟明; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Chen Ziliang 陳子良; his grandfather was Chen Huizhong 陳誨忠; his father was Chen Li 陳李 (District Magistrate [zhixian]); his legal mother was Lady Zheng 鄭氏; and his birth mother was Lady Liu 劉氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Jue 陳爵 and Chen Ping 陳泙. He is married to Lady Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 17th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 81st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Jin 許進: Registered under a civilian household in Lingbao County 靈寶縣, Shan Subprefecture 陝州, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan 河南; a county student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Jisheng 季升; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the third day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Xu Shixin 許仕信; his grandfather was Xu Shi 許實; his father was Xu Ju 許聚 (Instructor [jiaoyu]); and his mother was Lady He 何氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Xu Tong 許通 and Xu Di 許迪. He is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed 15th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 178th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Jin 余金: Registered under a physician household in Neijiang County 內江縣, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Gongzhi 貢之; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Yu Chaoqing 余朝卿; his grandfather was Yu Daosheng 余道昇; his father was Yu Gang 余綱; and his mother was Lady Wu 吳氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yu Yu 余玉 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), Yu Shan 余山, Yu Quan 余泉, Yu Lin 余琳, Yu Jie 余玠, and Yu Xuan 余瑄. He is married to Lady Hong 洪氏. He placed 56th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 252nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wu Fu 吳黼 (registered under a medical household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili]; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Chengzhang; first in his generation; age forty, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Daliang, his grandfather was Jin, his father is Tai (Medical Practitioner), and his mother is née Dai. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Fu. He married née Shen, and subsequently married née Gao and née Shen. He ranked eighty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and one hundred eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Chong 李冲 (registered under an artisan household in Anyang County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tengxiao; second in his generation; age thirty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Rongzu, his grandfather was Shida, his father is Jing, his mother was née Du, and his stepmother is née Cheng. His father is living. His elder brother is Fu, and his younger brothers are Chun and Yan. He married née Ma. He ranked thirty-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yin 劉寅 (registered under a civilian household in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Shuliang; fourth in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Renyi, his grandfather was Xian, his father is Zhixi (Prefectural Director of Studies), and his mother is née Huang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yuke, Yuyan, and Bo, and his younger brothers are Qi and Yujue. He married née Li. He ranked thirty-fourth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Xi 胡熈 (registered under a civilian household in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Zongwen; second in his generation; age thirty-six, [born on] the fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yanwen, his grandfather is Jizu, his father is Xue, his mother was née Jin, and his stepmother is née Li. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Xun, and his younger brothers are Mo and Jie. He married née Chen. He ranked fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and one hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yu Kang 余康 [native of [?], Fujian Province; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiqing 時清; third in seniority; aged twenty-seven; born on [?]]. His great-grandfather was Yu Ningfu 寧甫, his grandfather was Yu Yancheng 彥誠, his father is Yu Huizhen 惠珍, and his mother is née Luo 羅氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yu Shifeng 時豐, Yu Xu 序, and Yu Qing 慶. He is married to née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 47th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 99th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Qiao 劉喬 [native of Wan'an County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi Province, of official registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shuxian 述憲; eighth in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Zhaonian 昭年 [posthumously honored as Minister of Justice], his grandfather was Liu Junying 俊英 [posthumously honored as Minister of Justice], his father was Liu Guangheng 廣衡 [Minister of Justice], and his mother is née Kang 康氏 [invested as Lady of the First Rank]. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Liu Shugu 述古, Liu Yi 易, and Liu Xia 夏, and his younger brothers are Liu Shupu 述朴, Liu Shuke 述軻, Liu Xian 賢, and Liu Shuzhang 述章. He is married to née Ouyang 歐陽氏. He placed 2nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 102nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Deng Qi 鄧杞 [native of Guang'an Department, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan Province, of military registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Bangyong 邦用; third in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Deng Deying 德英 [posthumously honored as Platoon Commander], his grandfather was Deng Fucai 福才, his father is Deng Bin 濱, and his mother is née Yang 楊氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Deng Zhang 樟 and Deng Rong 榕, and his younger brothers are Deng Zhen 榛, Deng Ji 楫, Deng Gui 檜, and Deng Zhu 柱. He is married to née Jiang 姜氏. He placed 54th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 55th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Yu 嚴裕 [native of Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang Province, of civilian registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kekuan 克寬; fifth in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Yan Zicheng 子成, his grandfather was Yan Qi 玘 [invested as Investigating Censor], his father was Yan Yi 毅, and his mother is née Xu 許氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yan Si 祀, Yan Yin 禋, Yan Li 礼, and Yan Zuo 祚, and his younger brother is Yan Bian 褊. He is married to née Zhang 張氏. He placed 75th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 174th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Shi Huai 石淮: Registered in a military household of Jiangpu County, Yingtian Prefecture, he was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name was Zonghai, he was the first in seniority among his brothers, and he was twenty-five years old, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Shi Sishan, his grandfather was Shi Jingyan, his father was Shi Jin, and his mother was née Wang. Both of his parents were living. His younger brothers were Shi Chun, Shi Pu, Shi Jian, Shi Cheng, Shi Duo, and Shi Wu; he married née Yu. He placed ninth in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Gui 李珪: Registered in a civilian household of Tongzhou, Shaanxi, he was a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name was Tingqi, he was the third in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-six years old, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Li Yanzhong, his grandfather was Li Kuan, his father was Li Sen, and his mother was née Xu. Both of his parents were living. His elder brothers were Li Su and Li Heng, and his younger brothers were Li Xian, Li Wen, and Li Da; he married née Wang. He placed fiftieth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and three hundred fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Wei 孫偉: Originally from Xiushui County, Zhejiang, and registered in a military household of the Qujing Guard in Yunnan, he was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His courtesy name was Tingyan, he was the first in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-three years old, born on the thirtieth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Sun Qiong, his grandfather was Sun Bin, his father was Sun Lin, and his mother was née Wang. Both of his parents were living. His younger brother was Sun Jun; he married née Li, and took née Wu as his second wife. He placed fourth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zan 劉瓚: Registered in an artisan household of Yidu County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong, he was a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His courtesy name was Tingbi, he was the fourth in seniority among his brothers, and he was twenty-nine years old, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Zirong, his grandfather was Liu Duo, his father was Liu Ming, his legal mother was née Lan, and his birth mother was née Sha. Both of his parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Liu Qi, Liu Yu, and Liu Xi, and his younger brother was Liu Jin; he was betrothed to née Ding. He placed forty-fifth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Shanji 張善吉 [registered in a military household of Fuzhou Department, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; Department Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Benqian; first in his generation; age thirty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Bulong, his grandfather Zhang Deyu, his father Zhang Xuan [Prefectural Director of Studies], and his mother née Tang. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Mengji, Zhang Zhenji, and Zhang Daji. He married née Feng. He ranked thirty-sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and three hundred and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xun 王遜 [registered in a civilian household of Fengxiang County, Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Qianzhi; first in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Xi, his grandfather Wang Gang [Granary Assistant Commissioner], his father Wang Hai, his mother née Wang, and his stepmother née Fan. His father is living. His younger brother is Wang Rang. He married née Zhang. He ranked sixth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yi 陳誼 [registered in a civilian household of Dezhou Department, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Ziyi; first in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Bingzhong, his grandfather Chen Rong, his father Chen Shan [County Magistrate], his mother née Zhang, and his stepmother née He. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Chen Xun. He married née Wu, and remarried née Yang. He ranked eighty-sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Rang 劉讓 [registered in a civilian household of Chaoyi County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xunzhi; first in his generation; age thirty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Tai, his grandfather Liu Yantong, his father Liu Heng, and his mother née Wang. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Liu Hui and Liu Xun. He married née Qiu, and remarried née Ma. He ranked twentieth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Duan Cheng 端澄 (registered in Nanle County, Daming Prefecture, Zhili, under civilian registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Benqing; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the third day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Duan Shineng; his grandfather was Duan Xuan; his father is Duan Xin; his mother is née Sun. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Duan Shu, Duan Yuan, and Duan Hong. He married née Li. He placed 123rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 316th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Bogai 黃伯垓 (registered in Huanggang County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang, under military registration; County School Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Pengyuan; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-nine, born on the twentieth day of the intercalary fourth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Sheng; his grandfather was Huang Yu; his father was Huang Fu; his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. His elder brother is Huang Bokun; his younger brothers are Huang Boji and Huang Bojing. He married née Qin. He placed 27th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 156th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Run 蕭潤 (registered in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian registration; Confucian scholar; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Ren'en; second in seniority among brothers; age forty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Zhiyuan; his grandfather was Xiao Xinli (Guard Registrar); his father is Xiao Mengjie; his mother is née Guo. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Xiao Rensheng; his younger brothers are Xiao Renxing, Xiao Renzhuang, Xiao Song, Xiao Han, Xiao Shu, and Xiao Fan. He married née Wang. He placed 29th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 203rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wen Shu 文澍 (originally from Taoyuan County, Huguang, registered under military registration in Jinchi Guard, Yunnan; Guard School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rulin; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the sixth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wen Junyu; his grandfather was Wen Zongyi; his father was Wen Zheng; his mother is née Chen. His mother is living. His elder brother is Wen Hao; his younger brothers are Wen Shen and Wen Quan. He married née Xu. He placed 7th in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 20th in the Metropolitan Examination.
